title.en: Woman killed in Times Square stabbing, suspect shot dead by police
title.zh: 时代广场发生女子遭刺杀事件，嫌疑人被警方击毙

summary.en: Police report that a random double stabbing, which injured another person, was carried out by a suspect with a history of mental health issues, and the suspect was subsequently shot and killed by police.
summary.zh: 警方称，一起涉及另一人受伤的随机双重刺杀事件由一名有精神健康问题史的嫌疑人实施，嫌疑人随后被警方击毙。

body.en:
A 32-year-old woman has been killed and another victim is in hospital following a double stabbing in Times Square, New York late on Monday afternoon.

The suspect, a woman wielding two knives, was shot by police. All three people were taken to hospital, where the female victim and the suspect were later pronounced dead, Mayor Zohran Mamdani told a news conference.

The deceased victim was later identified as Erin Piacenti, a Bank of America employee. The male victim remains in a stable condition.

New York Police Department (NYPD) Commissioner Jessica Tisch described the attack as "unprovoked" and said the stabbings took place 20 seconds apart.

Citing preliminary information, Tisch said the NYPD call centre received several 911 calls at approximately 16:24 local time (21:00 BST) reporting a woman armed with two knives was stabbing people along Seventh Avenue in Times Square.

Police believe the incident began near West 41st Street and Seventh Ave, in Midtown Manhattan.

The suspect approached a man who had just exited the subway and was standing with his wife waiting to cross the street, Tisch told a news conference.

"A witness at the scene told investigators that he observed the subject remove two knives from a red Target bag before approaching the first victim.

"The subject waved the knives before stabbing a 68-year-old man in the right side of his abdomen, in what appears to be a random and unprovoked attack."

The suspect continued up Seventh Avenue towards 42nd Street, which is where she stabbed the second victim, Piacenti, who did not survive after being taken to hospital.

Bank of America said in a statement to the BBC: "We are shocked and deeply saddened by the tragic loss of our colleague. She was a valued teammate who will be greatly missed. Our hearts go out to her family and all of her loved ones."

The suspect continued on Seventh Avenue, which is when police tried to get her to drop her weapons, speaking to her for four minutes, the NYPD commissioner said.

"During the encounter she told the officers 'I'm not dropping anything, I'd rather kill both of you'. She repeated 'I will kill you'," Tisch said.

The suspect waved knives towards the officers, who then used Tasers, which were "ineffective" and did not stop her from heading towards them.

NYPD officers then shot the woman, who was later also pronounced dead at Bellevue Hospital.

The suspect was later identified as 49-year-old Pamela Cisneros of Queens, New York City. She had never previously been arrested but had a "documented mental health history with the NYPD, with one incident in 2018 and one in 2019", Tisch added.

A tourist from Boston, Melinda Puzon, told the BBC's US reporting partner CBS News that she heard the shots and saw "so many people on the street".
body.zh: 周一下午晚些时候，纽约时代广场发生双重刺伤事件，一名 32 岁妇女被杀，另一名受害者正在医院接受治疗。 嫌疑人是一名持两把刀的妇女，被警察开枪射杀。市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 在新闻发布会上说，三人都被送往医院，女性受害者和嫌疑人后来被宣布死亡。 死者后来被确认为美国银行员工艾琳·皮亚琴蒂(Erin Piacenti)。男性受害者目前情况稳定。 纽约警察局 (NYPD) 局长杰西卡·蒂施 (Jessica Tisch) 称此次袭击是“无端的”，并表示刺伤事件相隔 20 秒。 蒂施援引初步信息称，纽约警察局呼叫中心于当地时间 16:24（英国夏令时间 21:00）左右接到多个 911 电话，报告称一名持两把刀的女子正在时代广场第七大道刺伤行人。 警方认为这起事件始于曼哈顿中城西 41 街和第七大道附近。 蒂施在新闻发布会上说，嫌疑人走近一名刚刚走出地铁的男子，当时他和妻子正站在一起等待过马路。 “现场的一名目击者告诉调查人员，他观察到受害者在接近第一个受害者之前从红色 Target 包中取出了两把刀。 “嫌疑人挥舞着刀子，然后刺伤了一名 68 岁男子的右侧腹部，这似乎是一次随机且无端的袭击。” 嫌疑人继续沿第七大道前往第 42 街，在那里她刺伤了第二名受害者皮亚琴蒂 (Piacenti)，后者被送往医院后不治身亡。 美国银行在给 BBC 的一份声明中表示：“我们对同事的不幸去世感到震惊和深感悲痛。她是一位有价值的队友，我们将非常怀念她。我们的心与她的家人和她所有的亲人同在。” 纽约警察局局长说，嫌疑人继续在第七大道行驶，当时警方试图让她放下武器，并与她交谈了四分钟。 “在遭遇过程中，她告诉警察‘我不会掉落任何东西，我宁愿杀掉你们两个’。她重复了‘我会杀了你’，”蒂施说。 嫌疑人向警察挥舞刀子，警察随后使用泰瑟枪，但“无效”，并没有阻止她走向他们。 纽约警察局官员随后开枪射杀了这名女子，该女子后来也在贝尔维尤医院被宣布死亡。 嫌疑人后来被确认为纽约市皇后区 49 岁的帕梅拉·西斯内罗斯 (Pamela Cisneros)。蒂施补充说，她此前从未被捕，但“在纽约警察局有记录的心理健康史，其中一次发生在 2018 年，一次发生在 2019 年”。 来自波士顿的游客梅琳达·普松 (Melinda Puzon) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 美国报道合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻 (CBS News)，她听到了枪声，并看到“街上有很多人”。

reflection.en: The news from Times Square is a stark reminder of how violence begets violence. The suspect's aggression led to her death at the hands of police, illustrating the tragic cycle where force meets force. Jesus' words, 'all who draw the sword will die by the sword,' echo in such moments, calling us to seek paths of de-escalation and peace, even when confronted...
reflection.zh: 时代广场的这则新闻令人痛心地提醒我们，暴力如何滋生暴力。嫌疑人的攻击行为导致她被警方击毙，这说明了暴力对抗暴力的悲剧性循环。耶稣所说‘凡动刀的，必死在刀下’，在这样的时刻回响，呼唤我们在面对攻击时，也要寻求缓和与和平的道路。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
title.zh: 德国称莱比锡机场无人机袭击事件是俄罗斯所为

summary.en: Germany has stated that Russia was responsible for a drone incident at Leipzig/Halle Airport on August 4th, where a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered near Ukrainian cargo planes. The device failed to detonate, and investigators suspect a second drone may have collided with a nearby cargo aircraft....
summary.zh: 德国表示，8月4日发生在莱比锡/哈勒机场的一起无人机事件是俄罗斯所为。当时，一枚携带爆炸装置的无人机在乌克兰货运飞机附近被发现。该装置未能引爆，调查人员怀疑另一架无人机可能在附近与一架货运飞机相撞。德国官员称此次袭击是“俄罗斯在欧洲惯用的混合行动模式”的一部分。

body.en:
Germany has said Russia was responsible for last month's drone attack at Leipzig's airport.

A drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany, close to Ukrainian cargo planes, on 4 August.

It failed to explode as the detonator was apparently faulty, and investigators suspect a second drone collided with a cargo aircraft nearby.

Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said the attack on 4 August followed the "well-established pattern of Russian hybrid operations in Europe" and the assumption was that Germany would be targeted again.

Security experts had speculated that Russia may have been responsible, however Russia has until now rejected claims of involvement.

Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany is used by the Germany military and Nato allies for the transport of military goods and also serves as a base for Ukraine's Antonov Airlines - which carries most of the country's aerial cargo.

German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, who was standing beside Dobrindt at a press conference in Berlin, said he would order the closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn, and the contract for the Russian House in Berlin will also be terminated - which many observers have said has been used for espionage and to spread Russian propaganda.

This breaking news story is being updated and more details will be published shortly. Please refresh the page for the fullest version.

You can receive Breaking News on a smartphone or tablet via the BBC News App . You can also follow @BBCBreaking on X , external to get the latest alerts.
body.zh: 德国表示，俄罗斯对上个月莱比锡机场发生的无人机袭击事件负责。 8 月 4 日，在德国东部莱比锡/哈勒机场靠近乌克兰货机的地方发现了一架携带爆炸装置的无人机。 由于雷管明显有故障，它未能爆炸，调查人员怀疑第二架无人机与附近的一架货机相撞。 内政部长亚历山大·多布林特表示，8 月 4 日的袭击遵循“俄罗斯在欧洲混合行动的既定模式”，并假设德国将再次成为攻击目标。 安全专家推测俄罗斯可能对此负责，但俄罗斯迄今为止否认参与其中。 德国东部的莱比锡/哈勒机场被德国军方和北约盟国用来运输军用物资，也是乌克兰安东诺夫航空公司的基地，该航空公司承运该国大部分航空货物。 在柏林举行的新闻发布会上，站在多布林特旁边的德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔表示，他将下令关闭俄罗斯驻波恩领事馆，柏林俄罗斯之家的合同也将被终止——许多观察家称该建筑已被用于间谍活动和传播俄罗斯宣传。 此突发新闻报道正在更新，更多详细信息将很快发布。请刷新页面以获得完整版本。 您可以通过 BBC 新闻应用程序在智能手机或平板电脑上接收突发新闻。您还可以在外部 X 上关注 @BBCBreaking 以获取最新警报。

reflection.en: The discovery of a drone with an explosive device at Leipzig airport, attributed by Germany to Russian 'hybrid operations,' highlights the insidious nature of conflict that operates below the threshold of open warfare. It raises the question of how to respond when faced with such indirect aggression, which seeks to destabilize and instill fear without...
reflection.zh: 在莱比锡机场发现一枚携带爆炸装置的无人机，德国方面将其归咎于俄罗斯的“混合行动”，这凸显了冲突潜伏于公开战争之下的阴险本质。它提出了一个问题：当面对这种旨在制造不稳定和恐惧而非直接对抗的间接侵略时，应如何回应？古老的智慧提醒我们，要抵制以牙还牙的冲动，而是要寻求通过持之以恒的善来克服邪恶，这是一条艰难但最终更有希望的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: German police investigating reported explosives at Brandenburg power substation – Europe live
title.zh: 俄罗斯夜袭乌克兰至少造成12人死亡

summary.en: Russian overnight attacks have killed at least 12 people and injured dozens more, leaving thousands without electricity in Ukraine's Odesa region. Ukraine's air force reported that Russia launched over 2,800 jet-powered drones in August, with an interception rate of about 60% for these harder-to-shoot-down models.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯的夜间袭击已造成至少12人死亡，数十人受伤，使乌克兰敖德萨地区数千人断电。乌克兰空军报告称，俄罗斯在8月份发射了超过2800架喷气式无人机，其中较难拦截的型号的拦截率约为60%。

body.en:
As reported earlier, we are expecting to hear from the German government later this afternoon, formally blaming Russia for the recent attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport ( 10:17 ).

But in the meanwhile, German police are investigating some explosives found at a power substation in Turnow-Preilack in Brandenburg, near the coal-fired Jänschwalde power plant.

“Evidence is being secured,” a police spokesperson told German news agency DPA . “Bomb disposal experts are on site.”

Some damage to a power line was discovered this morning, Die Welt said . Local media outlet Märkische Allgemeine reported that explosives had been found and defused at the scene, but police insisted there was no danger to the public.

Investigators believe the explosives were intended to cause a widespread power outage, but network operator 50Hertz told MAZ that there was only a “brief interruption” to its services.

It further told Reuters that “as yet unidentified perpetrators are believed to have caused damage to ⁠several power lines in 50Hertz’s transmission ​grid.”

As often with breaking news story, it’s important to remember that we do not know anything about who could be behind this incident and it may well be a very different story to the Leipzig incident.

Handesblatt noted that in January a group of suspected left-wing extremists set fire to and short-circuited power lines near a different plant in southwest Berlin.
body.zh: 泽连斯基表示，敖德萨地区的罢工导致数千人断电，造成数十人受伤。乌克兰空军发言人尤里·伊纳特 (Yuriy Ihnat) 周二表示，俄罗斯 8 月在乌克兰发射了超过 2,800 架难以击落的喷气式无人机。伊纳特在路透社报道的评论中告诉乌克兰电视台，与其他类型的无人机相比，它们的拦截率较低，约为 60%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless nature of the attacks, causing widespread destruction and leaving thousands in darkness, speaks to a deep and ongoing suffering. In such times, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a profound truth: 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.' Even...
reflection.zh: 袭击的持续性造成大范围破坏，使数千人陷入黑暗，这反映了一种深刻而持续的苦难。在这样的时刻，《耶利米哀歌》中的古老话语提供了一个深刻的真理：“雅伟的慈爱永不枯竭；他的怜悯每早更新；你的信实广大。”即使在毁灭之中，雅伟永恒信实的应许也带来一丝希望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Burnham promises to bring ‘substantial change’ as he gives first Commons address as prime minister – UK politics live
title.zh: 首相在成为首相后首次向议员发表讲话，表示希望释放“积极性”——英国政治直播

summary.en: The Prime Minister will bring an upbeat message to the adversarial Commons after a summer of policy announcements and improved poll ratings. Alex Norris, the Justice Secretary, has insisted prisons will "still function properly" amid concerns over government plans to turn laundries into cells in a bid to tackle...
summary.zh: 在夏季公布政策并提高民意支持率后，首相将向充满对抗性的下议院带来积极的信息。司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯坚称，在政府计划将洗衣房改建成牢房以解决过度拥挤问题的担忧中，监狱将“仍然正常运作”。司法部宣布将斥资1.1亿英镑，利用现有的空间，如空置办公室、洗衣房和其他区域，在监狱中建造新牢房。

body.en: PM says he has a ‘clear diagnosis of what has gone wrong’ with UK, and pays tribute to Keir Starmer after his predecessor quit parliament My colleague Richard Partington , the Guardian’s senior economics correspondent, grew up, like Andy Burnham, in the Warrington suburb of Culcheth. He has been home to find out what people there are saying about the new PM. Yesterday, Kemi Badenoch announced a reshuffle, replacing Mel Stride with Andrew Griffith as shadow chancellor and Priti Patel with Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过一个夏天的政策宣布和民调支持率的提高，总理将向敌对的下议院传达乐观的信息。司法部长亚历克斯·诺里斯坚称监狱将“仍然正常运作”，因为人们对政府计划将洗衣房改成牢房以解决人满为患的问题感到担忧。据本·奎因报道，司法部连夜宣布，将斥资 1.1 亿英镑在监狱中利用现有空间（如未使用的办公室、洗衣房和其他区域）建造新牢房。当然，我们要确保监狱仍然能够正常运作。正如我所说，这是一种创造性的外观，围绕着我们的庄园，并且能够利用一些我们可以重新确定优先级的空间。这些不一定是我会使用的数字，但地方可能来自庄园。例如，你知道，可能会造成损坏、火灾损坏。我们有一处非常古老的庄园。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The government's plan to convert laundry rooms into prison cells, while aiming to address overcrowding, raises questions about the dignity and justice afforded within the penal system. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God. This principle encourages a thoughtful approach to governance, ensuring that solutions to practical...
reflection.zh: 政府将洗衣房改建成监狱牢房的计划，虽然旨在解决过度拥挤问题，但引发了对监狱系统内尊严和公正的疑问。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。这一原则鼓励一种深思熟虑的治理方式，确保实际问题的解决方案不损害基本的道德标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Summer of 2026 was UK’s hottest on record, Met Office says
title.zh: 英国气象局称2026年夏季为英国有记录以来最热的夏季

summary.en: Provisional data from the Met Office indicates that this past summer was the UK's hottest on record, with a mean average temperature of 16.5°C. Meteorologists attribute this extreme heat, which made such temperatures 130 times more likely, to the climate crisis driven by fossil fuel consumption. Record-breaking...
summary.zh: 根据英国气象局的初步数据，今年夏季是英国有记录以来最热的夏季，平均气温为16.5摄氏度。气象学家指出，气候危机使此类高温出现的可能性增加了130倍。创纪录的热浪席卷了欧洲大部分地区，英格兰在8月份的最高气温达到了38.1摄氏度。

body.en: Meteorologists say mean average temperature of 16.5C was made 130 times more likely by climate crisis This year’s summer was the UK’s hottest on record, according to provisional data, and the Met Office said the season’s mean temperature was made 130 times more likely by the climate crisis. Record-breaking and back-to-back heatwaves have scorched much of Europe. In England, temperatures peaked at 38.1C (100.1F) at Kew Gardens in London on 13 August, and June had already been confirmed as the country’s hottest since records began in 1884 . Scientists have said these heatwaves are only possible because of the climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels. Continue reading...
body.zh: 气象学家表示，气候危机使平均气温达到 16.5 摄氏度的可能性增加了 130 倍根据临时数据，今年的夏季是英国有记录以来最热的夏季，英国气象局表示，气候危机使本季平均气温达到 16.5 摄氏度的可能性增加了 130 倍。 Record-breaking and back-to-back heatwaves have scorched much of Europe.在英国，8 月 13 日，伦敦邱园的气温达到了 38.1 摄氏度（100.1 华氏度）的峰值，6 月已被确认为该国自 1884 年有记录以来最热的月份。 Scientists have said these heatwaves are only possible because of the climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels.继续阅读...

reflection.en: The record-breaking heat in the UK this summer serves as a stark reminder of our planet's fragility and the profound impact of human activity. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' As stewards of this creation, we are called to care for it with wisdom and responsibility, recognizing that it is not ours to exploit but a...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天英国创纪录的高温提醒我们地球的脆弱性以及人类活动带来的深远影响。《诗篇》24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。” 作为这受造界的管家，我们蒙召要以智慧和责任来照管它，认识到它并非供我们剥削，而是造物主托付给我们的恩赐。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: ‘Start being serious’: Canada’s Carney hits back at US officials as tariff talks stall – live
title.zh: “开始认真对待”：卡尼在关税谈判陷入僵局之际回击美国官员——直播

summary.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney is responding to US officials who are blaming Canada for a trade war, with one US official stating that trade tension with Canada is 'more their emergency than ours.' Meanwhile, Democratic senator Chuck Schumer is introducing a bill to reverse recent US tariffs on Canadian goods, aiming to...
summary.zh: 总理马克·卡尼正在回应那些指责加拿大挑起贸易战的美国官员，其中一位美国官员表示，与加拿大的贸易紧张局势“是他们的紧急情况，而非我们的”。与此同时，民主党参议员查克·舒默正在提出一项法案，以撤销美国近期对加拿大商品征收的关税，旨在解决可负担性危机。

body.en: PM Mark Carney responds to US officials who blame Canada for trade war; Jamieson Greer says trade tension with Canada is ‘more their emergency than ours’ Sign up for the US Breaking News email Democratic senator Chuck Schumer is introducing a bill that would reverse Donald Trump’s most recent tariffs, among them the new 50% duty on Canadian goods, MS Now reported . While the Senate minority leader’s proposed legislation has virtually no chance of becoming law, Schumer hopes that his proposal shows that Democrats are actively fighting the affordability crisis. Schumer first shared his proposed legislation with MS Now. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克·卡尼总理回应美国官员指责加拿大发动贸易战的言论；据 MS Now 报道，杰米森·格里尔 (Jamieson Greer) 表示，与加拿大的贸易紧张局势“比我们更紧急”。 据 MS Now 报道，民主党参议员查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer) 正在提出一项法案，该法案将扭转唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 最近的关税，其中包括对加拿大商品征收 50% 的新关税。虽然参议院少数党领袖提出的立法几乎没有机会成为法律，但舒默希望他的提案表明民主党正在积极应对负担能力危机。舒默首先与 MS Now 分享了他提议的立法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Trade negotiations between Canada and the United States have stalled, leading to escalating tensions and sharp words. The principle of pursuing peace, even amidst disagreement, calls for a different approach than escalating rhetoric. May leaders seek wisdom and a spirit of reconciliation to find common ground and resolve these disputes constructively.
reflection.zh: 加拿大和美国之间的贸易谈判陷入僵局，导致紧张局势升级和言语交锋。在分歧中仍要追求和平的原则，要求采取不同于升级言辞的方式。愿领导人寻求智慧与和解的精神，以建设性地找到共同点并解决这些争端。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
title.zh: 塞塔几乎每天都发生性侵犯，检察官说

summary.en: Most migrants have returned to neighbouring Morocco, but as many as 5,000 remain in the Spanish exclave. Spanish prosecutors say 23 sexual assaults, including nine against children, have been recorded in Ceuta since the mass influx of migrants into the Spanish exclave at the end of July.
summary.zh: 大多数移民已返回邻近的摩洛哥，但仍有高达 5,000 人滞留在西班牙飞地。西班牙检察官称，自 7 月底大量移民涌入西班牙飞地以来，塞塔已记录了 23 起性侵犯案件，其中包括 9 起针对儿童的案件。

body.en:
Spanish prosecutors say 23 sexual assaults, including nine against children, have been recorded in Ceuta since the mass influx of migrants into the Spanish exclave at the end of July.

That number meant there was almost one case every day, Ceuta's chief prosecutor Silvia Rojas said.

She told El País newspaper migrant girls were "particularly vulnerable because of their irregular status in the territory".

At least 72,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into Ceuta on 30 and 31 July and although most have returned, as many as 5,000 remain - leading to unrest in the autonomous city in North Africa and a crisis for Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

Between 1,400 and 1,600 of the estimated 5,000 migrants still in Ceuta are children, according to Rojas.

Among the suspected attackers are four Moroccans, three Spaniards and a Belgian, Efe news agency reports.

There have been scenes of violence in recent days as tensions flare up between migrants and local residents.

Sánchez called the second meeting of his national security council in a week on Tuesday to tackle the issue.

Rojas said the influx had led to an exponential increase in sexual assault, and many victims did not file a report, either out of fear of because of their "current situation in Ceuta".

The Spanish Society of Epidemiology said the border crisis had highlighted the difficulty in detecting and tackling violence against migrant women and girls.

One 24-year-old woman from Morocco told the BBC she had " put her life in danger" by travelling to Ceuta, and described being sexually assaulted while sleeping among a group of men and women. "I was shocked… If I had known this, I wouldn't have come."

Emergency doctor Susana Ascaso said last month her department at Ceuta University Hospital had treated several sexual assault victims, including one who was just 10 years old.

Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo said a multi-million euro aid package had been approved by the cabinet that would help provide essential services and cover care for unaccompanied children.

The territory's conservative mayor, Juan Jesús Vivas, has called on Spaniards to take part in demonstrations across mainland Spain in support of Ceuta on Wednesday, which coincides with the city's annual holiday.

The Spanish government is facing bitter criticism from its opponents for its handling of the crisis. The hard-right Vox party said Sánchez had not "lost control of Ceuta - he has handed it over".

Arantxa Campos, president of the Ceuta Employers' Confederation, told the BBC: "We can't do anything unless these people leave.

"We don't have a plan from the government. We don't have anything. We don't even know when they're going to finish screening everyone."

The prime minister said on Monday that King Felipe VI would visit...
body.zh: 西班牙检察官表示，自 7 月底大量移民涌入西班牙飞地以来，休达已记录了 23 起性侵犯事件，其中包括 9 起针对儿童的性侵犯事件。 休达首席检察官西尔维娅·罗哈斯说，这个数字意味着几乎每天都会发生一起案件。 她告诉《国家报》，移民女孩“由于她们在该地区的非正常身份而特别容易受到伤害”。 7 月 30 日至 31 日，至少有 72,000 名移民从摩洛哥越境进入休达，尽管大多数人已经返回，但仍有多达 5,000 人留下，导致北非自治城市的骚乱以及西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯的危机。 罗哈斯表示，目前仍在休达的估计 5,000 名移民中有 1,400 至 1,600 人是儿童。 据埃菲通讯社报道，涉嫌袭击者包括四名摩洛哥人、三名西班牙人和一名比利时人。 最近几天，随着移民和当地居民之间的紧张关系加剧，暴力场面不断出现。 桑切斯周二召开了一周内的第二次国家安全委员会会议来解决这个问题。 罗哈斯表示，人潮的涌入导致性侵犯事件呈指数级增长，许多受害者没有提交报告，要么是因为“休达目前的情况”而感到恐惧。 西班牙流行病学协会表示，边境危机凸显了发现和解决针对移民妇女和女童的暴力行为的困难。 一名来自摩洛哥的 24 岁女性告诉 BBC，她前往休达“将自己的生命置于危险之中”，并描述了在与一群男人和女人一起睡觉时遭到性侵犯的情况。 “我很震惊……如果我知道这一点，我就不会来了。” 急诊医生苏珊娜·阿斯卡索 (Susana Ascaso) 上个月表示，她在休达大学医院 (Ceuta University Hospital) 的科室治疗了几名性侵犯受害者，其中一名年仅 10 岁。 经济部长卡洛斯·库尔波表示，内阁已批准一项数百万欧元的援助计划，该计划将有助于提供基本服务并为无人陪伴的儿童提供照顾。 该地区的保守派市长胡安·赫苏斯·维瓦斯呼吁西班牙人周三参加西班牙大陆各地的示威活动，以支持休达，恰逢该市的年度假期。 西班牙政府处理危机的方式正面临反对者的严厉批评。极右翼的 Vox 党表示，桑切斯并没有“失去对休达的控制——他已经把它交给了”。 休达雇主联合会主席阿兰查·坎波斯告诉英国广播公司：“除非这些人离开，否则我们无能为力。 “我们没有政府的计划。我们什么都没有。我们甚至不知道他们什么时候才能完成对每个人的筛查。” 首相周一表示，国王费利佩六世将访问......

reflection.en: The report from Ceuta reveals a grim reality where migrant girls are particularly vulnerable, facing sexual assaults with alarming frequency. This situation calls us to remember the ancient wisdom urging us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all the defenseless who are being wronged." Our hearts should ache for these young lives...
reflection.zh: 塞塔的报道揭示了一个严峻的现实，那里的移民女孩特别容易受到伤害，并以惊人的频率遭受性侵犯。这种情况提醒我们，要牢记古老的智慧，它敦促我们“为那些不能为自己说话的人说话，为所有受不公正待遇的无助者说话。” 我们应该为这些身处如此危险境地中的年轻生命感到心痛，并呼吁保护他们的安全和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Todd Haynes and Wallace Shawn among signatories of letter backing Mark Ruffalo amid antisemitism charge
title.zh: 托德·海恩斯和华莱士·肖恩等签署信函，支持马克·鲁法洛免受反犹主义指控

summary.en: Over 170 Jewish artists, including Todd Haynes, Joel Coen, Miranda July, and Wallace Shawn, have signed an open letter supporting actor Mark Ruffalo. Ruffalo faced accusations of invoking antisemitic tropes after criticizing Paramount Skydance, a media company owned by David Ellison, an ally of Donald Trump. The actor...
summary.zh: 包括托德·海恩斯、乔尔·科恩、米兰达·裘莱和华莱士·肖恩在内的170多位犹太艺术家签署了一封公开信，支持演员马克·鲁法洛。鲁法洛在批评了唐纳德·特朗普盟友大卫·埃里森拥有的媒体公司派拉蒙天空舞（Paramount Skydance）后，面临被指控援引反犹主义的陈词滥调。这位演员曾就一项重大的合并交易发表过看法。

body.en: More than 170 Jewish artists, also including Joel Coen, Hannah Einbinder and Miranda July, have supported the actor after he criticized Paramount A collective of more than 170 prominent Jewish artists – including Todd Haynes , Joel Coen , Miranda July , Hannah Einbinder , Wallace Shawn and Naomi Klein – have signed an open letter supporting Mark Ruffalo . The actor had been accused of invoking antisemitic tropes after he criticized Paramount Skydance, the media company owned by David Ellison, a Donald Trump ally. Ruffalo had spoken out about the $111bn merger with Warner Bros Discovery (WBD). Continue reading...
body.zh: 在马克·鲁法洛批评派拉蒙之后，包括乔尔·科恩、汉娜·艾因宾德和米兰达·朱莉在内的 170 多名犹太艺术家纷纷支持马克·鲁法洛。包括托德·海恩斯、乔尔·科恩、米兰达·朱莉、汉娜·艾因宾德、华莱士·肖恩和娜奥米·克莱因在内的 170 多名著名犹太艺术家集体签署了一封支持马克·鲁法洛的公开信。这位演员在批评唐纳德·特朗普盟友大卫·埃里森拥有的媒体公司派拉蒙 Skydance 后被指控援引反犹太主义比喻。鲁法洛曾公开谈论与华纳兄弟探索公司 (WBD) 价值 1,110 亿美元的合并案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In public discourse, accusations can fly quickly, and it is easy for a narrative to solidify without all sides being fully heard. This letter, signed by many Jewish artists, seeks to offer a different perspective on Mark Ruffalo's comments, reminding us of the importance of considering multiple viewpoints before judgment. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this,...
reflection.zh: 在公共讨论中，指控可能迅速传开，叙事很容易在未充分听取各方意见的情况下就固定下来。这封由众多犹太艺术家签署的信函，试图为马克·鲁法洛的言论提供不同的视角，提醒我们在评判之前考虑多方观点的必要性。《箴言》18:17对此有所提及：“先说话的似乎有理，直到别人来辩论，才显出真相。”

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: France hits Shein and Temu with fast fashion fees
title.zh: 法国对快时尚巨头Shein和Temu征收费用

summary.en: France has begun levying fees on "ultra-fast fashion" items, a measure that could reach nearly €20 per garment by 2030. This initiative, part of a new law passed in June, aims to regulate companies like Shein and Temu, which are criticized for driving the surge in cheap apparel sales. China's commerce ministry has...
summary.zh: 法国已开始对“超快时尚”商品征收费用，该措施到2030年可能达到每件近20欧元。这项新法于6月通过，旨在监管Shein和Temu等公司，它们因推动廉价服装销售激增而受到批评。中国商务部称该法具有歧视性，构成贸易壁垒。

body.en:
France has started imposing fees on fast fashion items which could reach almost €20 per garment by 2030, as the government tries to curb sales of cheap clothing sold by e-commerce sites.

The levy, which came into force on Tuesday, follows a new law passed in June to regulate so-called "ultra-fast fashion" companies such as Shein, Temu and AliExpress.

The e-commerce giants, known for selling large volumes of cheap apparel, have been criticised by French officials for driving a surge in ultra-fast fashion.

China's commerce ministry has described the French law as discriminatory and a trade barrier, saying it could violate World Trade Organization (WTO) principles.

French minister Mathieu Lefevre said the "harmful effects of ultra-fast fashion" on the environment and economy were "well known".

In July, Lefevre's office said the levy would not apply to retailers such as H&M or Zara, prompting some to say that the measure appeared to spare European companies.

Under the legislation, ultra-fast fashion will be determined according to two factors: the volume of clothing placed on the market and the cost of repairing garments relative to their purchase price.

The per-item fee will vary on a set scale according to how each product scores on both these standards.

For 2026, the charges range from a €0.50 (£0.43) levy on underwear to €2 (£1.71) for T-shirts, to €9 (£7.71) for jeans and €12 (£10.28) for a jacket.

The levy could reach up to €19.50 (£16.71/$22.60) per item by 2030, though the cap remains at 50% of the product's pre-tax price.

The fees come after Shein, a fast fashion retailer founded in China and headquartered in Singapore, was valued at $26.2bn (£19.3bn) on its first day of public trading on the stock market in Hong Kong.

The company was once estimated to be worth nearly $100bn, but has faced heated competition, trade tensions and questions over the ethics of its supply chain.

Shein previously told the BBC that the impact of legislation targeting ultra-fast fashion would "worsen the purchasing power of French consumers, at a time when they are already feeling the impact of the cost-of-living crisis".

Temu, a Chinese-owned e-commerce company, has also been widely criticised by politicians in the UK and US alike.

A spokesperson for Temu previously told the BBC that the brand "acknowledges the important environmental concerns addressed by the proposed French legislation", and argued that it does not operate as a fast fashion company because it is a marketplace and does not manufacture its own products.
body.zh: 法国已开始对快时尚商品征收费用，到 2030 年，每件衣服的价格可能达到近 20 欧元，因为政府试图遏制电子商务网站销售的廉价服装。 这项征税是在六月份通过的一项新法律之后生效的，该法律旨在监管 Shein、Temu 和 AliExpress 等所谓的“超快时尚”公司。 这家以销售大量廉价服装而闻名的电子商务巨头因推动超快时尚浪潮而受到法国官员的批评。 中国商务部称法国法律具有歧视性和贸易壁垒，称其可能违反世界贸易组织（WTO）原则。 法国部长Mathieu Lefevre表示，“超快时尚”对环境和经济的有害影响是“众所周知的”。 7 月，勒费弗尔办公室表示，这项征税不适用于 H&M 或 Zara 等零售商，这促使一些人表示，这项措施似乎让欧洲公司幸免于难。 根据该立法，超快时尚将根据两个因素来确定：投放市场的服装数量以及相对于购买价格的服装修补成本。 每件商品的费用将根据每种产品在这两个标准上的得分在一定范围内变化。 2026 年，收费范围从内衣 0.50 欧元（0.43 英镑）到 T 恤 2 欧元（1.71 英镑），牛仔裤 9 欧元（7.71 英镑），夹克 12 欧元（10.28 英镑）。 到 2030 年，每件商品的征税额可能高达 19.50 欧元（16.71 英镑/22.60 美元），但上限仍为产品税前价格的 50%。 这笔费用是在Shein（一家在中国成立、总部位于新加坡的快时尚零售商）在香港股市公开交易首日估值达到262亿美元（193亿英镑）之后提出的。 该公司的估值曾一度估计接近 1000 亿美元，但目前面临着激烈的竞争、贸易紧张局势以及供应链道德问题。 Shein此前告诉BBC，针对超快时尚的立法的影响将“削弱法国消费者的购买力，而此时他们已经感受到了生活成本危机的影响”。 中国电子商务公司 Temu 也受到英国和美国政界人士的广泛批评。 Temu 的一位发言人此前告诉 BBC，该品牌“承认拟议的法国立法解决了重要的环境问题”，并辩称，它不是一家快时尚公司，因为它是一个市场，不生产自己的产品。

reflection.en: Governments are called to enact justice and protect the vulnerable. France's new levy on "ultra-fast fashion" targets companies criticized for environmental and labor impacts, seeking to curb the sale of cheap, high-volume apparel. This action reflects a governmental attempt to balance economic activity with broader societal and ecological well-being.
reflection.zh: 政府蒙召施行公义，保护弱者。法国对“超快时尚”公司征收新税，旨在遏制被批评对环境和劳工有影响的廉价服装销售。此举反映了政府试图平衡经济活动与更广泛的社会及生态福祉的努力。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: War and sanctions deepen Iran's fuel crisis
title.zh: 战争与制裁加剧伊朗燃料危机

summary.en: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints, and new US sanctions squeeze supplies. Drivers report hours-long waits, with some arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel. The situation is even more difficult for diesel.
summary.zh: 由于战争破坏、进口限制和新的美国制裁导致供应紧张，伊朗各地的加油站排起了长队。司机们报告说需要排数小时的队，有些人甚至在午夜前就到场或睡在车里以确保获得燃料。柴油的情况甚至更加困难。

body.en:
Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze supplies.

Only days after Washington announced a new round of economic sanctions on Iran , the country's gasoline shortage has become increasingly visible on the streets.  

In cities across Iran , drivers are reporting hours-long waits at filling stations. Videos circulating on social media show some people arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel the following morning. Some stations have closed before serving everyone in line.

The situation is even more difficult for diesel. Truck drivers say queues at filling stations near major cities can stretch for kilometers, forcing them to wait overnight simply to obtain enough fuel to return to work.

Iran already faces a gasoline deficit of roughly 15 million liters a day. War damage, difficulties importing refined products and a tightening US blockade have made an old structural problem much harder to manage.

A resident of Karaj, west of Tehran, told DW that some filling stations were limiting individual purchases to around five liters.

"I'm in the gasoline line right now. It took about 45 minutes just to get this far," he said. "Yesterday I went to several stations. Some were closed, some had no gasoline and others had very long queues."

He said he returned at 6 a.m. the next morning hoping to avoid the crowds but again found a long line.

He suspects the shortages are partly being used to prepare public opinion for higher gasoline prices , a claim that cannot be independently verified.

"Our whole life is either spent in the diesel line or on the road," one driver said. He described sleeping at a station while waiting for a tanker that might arrive around midday and supply only a few dozen trucks.

Another driver said he had been waiting since 8 a.m. after failing to obtain diesel the previous day.

For drivers whose earnings depend directly on keeping their vehicles moving, every lost day adds to rising insurance, tire, oil, repair and maintenance costs.

The shortage has coincided with the use of methanol in domestically produced gasoline.

Vahid Ghaneifard, chief executive of Persian Gulf Star Oil Company, recently confirmed that the refinery had begun testing methanol as an oxygenate in its gasoline.

The company says methanol makes up around 0.5% of the mixture. Iran's refining authorities say the national fuel standard permits methanol concentrations of up to 3%.

Videos shared online show motorists holding bottles of unusually clear fuel and claiming that gasoline quality has deteriorated.

Some have alleged that water or excessive alcohol is being mixed into supplies. The allegations have not been independently corroborated.

There has,...
body.zh: 由于战争破坏、进口限制和美国新制裁挤压了供应，伊朗各地加油站排起了长队。 就在华盛顿宣布对伊朗实施新一轮经济制裁几天后，该国的汽油短缺问题在街头变得越来越明显。 在伊朗各地的城市，司机们都报告说在加油站要等待数小时。社交媒体上流传的视频显示，一些人在午夜前到达或睡在车里，以确保第二天早上有燃料。有些车站在为排队的所有人提供服务之前就已经关闭。 对于柴油机来说，情况更加困难。卡车司机表示，主要城市附近加油站的排队队伍可能长达数公里，迫使他们彻夜等待，以获得足够的燃料返回工作岗位。 伊朗已面临每天约 1500 万升的汽油短缺。战争造成的破坏、进口成品油的困难以及美国收紧的封锁使得这个古老的结构性问题更加难以解决。 德黑兰西部卡拉季的一名居民告诉德国之声，一些加油站将个人购买量限制在五升左右。 “我现在正在加油线上。花了大约 45 分钟才走到这一步，”他说。 “昨天我去了几个车站。有些车站关门了，有些没有汽油了，还有的还排着很长的队。” 他说，他第二天早上 6 点回来，希望避开人群，但又发现排着长队。 他怀疑短缺在一定程度上被用来为汽油价格上涨做好舆论准备，这一说法无法得到独立证实。 “我们的一生要么在柴油管道上度过，要么在路上度过，”一位司机说。他描述说，他在车站睡觉，等待一辆油罐车，这辆油罐车可能在中午左右到达，只能供应几十辆卡车。 另一名司机表示，由于前一天未能获得柴油，他从早上 8 点就开始等待。 对于收入直接依赖于保持车辆行驶的司机来说，每损失一天都会增加保险、轮胎、机油、维修和保养成本。 短缺与国内生产的汽油中使用甲醇同时发生。 波斯湾之星石油公司首席执行官瓦希德·加内法德 (Vahid Ghaneifard) 最近证实，该炼油厂已开始测试甲醇作为汽油中的含氧化合物。 该公司表示，甲醇占混合物的 0.5% 左右。伊朗炼油当局表示，国家燃料标准允许甲醇浓度最高为3%。 网上分享的视频显示，驾车者拿着异常透明的汽油瓶，声称汽油质量已经恶化。 一些人声称，供应品中混入了​​水或过量酒精。这些指控尚未得到独立证实。 有，...

reflection.en: The people of Iran face immense hardship as fuel becomes scarce, impacting daily life and livelihoods. In such times of severe economic strain, Habakkuk’s words offer a profound perspective: even when the harvest fails and livestock perish, there is a source of enduring joy and strength in Yahweh. This ancient lament reminds us that true sustenance...
reflection.zh: 伊朗人民正面临巨大的困境，因为燃料短缺，影响了日常生活和生计。在如此严峻的经济压力下，哈巴谷的话提供了一个深刻的视角：即使收成歉收，牲畜灭绝，在雅伟里仍有持久的喜乐和力量之源。 这古老的哀歌提醒我们，真正的滋养超越物质的匮乏。它呼唤我们超越眼前的苦难，看到更深的盼望，在匮乏中找到忠诚所带来的韧性，甚至喜乐。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Norway's new king takes oath as mourners pay respects to his late father
title.zh: 挪威新国王宣誓就职，民众悼念其父王

summary.en: Norway's new King Haakon VIII has sworn an oath before parliament in Oslo, marking a significant step in his reign. The ceremony included a moment of silence for his late father, King Harald V, who passed away on Friday. The King's wife, Queen Mette-Marit, was absent due to recovery from a lung transplant. Mourners...
summary.zh: 挪威新国王哈康八世在奥斯陆议会宣誓就职，这是他统治生涯中的一个重要步骤。仪式上，议会为周五去世的已故国王哈拉尔五世默哀。国王的妻子梅特-玛丽特王后因肺移植术后康复缺席了仪式。民众开始在皇家宫殿瞻仰已故国王的灵柩，灵柩将在此陈列至9月8日。

body.en:
Norway's Haakon VIII has sworn an oath before parliament in Oslo in the first major step of his reign as King.

During Tuesday's ceremony, parliament also held a minute's silence for Haakon's father, the late King Harald V, who died on Friday.

Haakon's wife, Queen Mette-Marit, was absent from the formalities as she continues to recover from a lung transplant.

Following the ceremony, mourners began paying their respects at the late King's coffin, which is lying in state at the Royal Palace until 8 September.
body.zh: 挪威哈康八世在奥斯陆议会面前宣誓，这是他就任国王的第一步。 在周二的仪式上，议会还为哈康的父亲、已故国王哈拉尔五世默哀一分钟，后者于周五去世。 哈康的妻子梅特-玛丽特王后因肺移植手术仍在恢复中，没有出席仪式。 仪式结束后，哀悼者开始向已故国王的灵柩致以敬意，该灵柩一直安放在皇宫中，直到 9 月 8 日为止。

reflection.en: The transition of a monarch is a profound moment, marking the end of one chapter and the beginning of another. King Haakon VIII assumes his duties as his father, King Harald V, is honored in death. This solemn occasion reminds us that all earthly reigns, like seasons, have their appointed times, a truth echoed in Ecclesiastes: 'For everything there is a...
reflection.zh: 君主制的权力交接是一个庄严的时刻，标志着一个时代的结束和另一个时代的开始。哈康八世国王在父亲哈拉尔五世国王的逝世受到追思之际，承担起他的职责。这个肃穆的场合提醒我们，世间所有的统治，如同四季更迭，都有其注定的时节，正如《传道书》所言：“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。”

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Mladic's death, Bosnia and Serbia's unfinished reckoning
title.zh: 姆拉迪奇之死，波黑与塞尔维亚未竟的清算

summary.en: The death of Ratko Mladic did not conclude a dark chapter of European history; instead, it reopened old wounds, demonstrating that the Dayton Accords and subsequent international efforts failed to address the root causes of the Bosnian war. The ideology that fueled the conflict persists.
summary.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并未结束欧洲历史上的黑暗篇章；相反，它重新撕裂了旧伤口，表明结束波斯尼亚战争的《代顿协议》以及随后的国际努力，都未能触及冲突的根源。催生这场冲突的意识形态依然存在。

body.en:
The death of Ratko Mladic did not close a dark chapter of European history; it reopened old wounds. The ideology that created him lives on. The Dayton peace agreement ended the war, not the divisions that produced it.

The death of Ratko Mladic should have closed one of the darkest chapters in European history.

Instead, it has reopened old wounds, proving that both the Dayton Accords that ended the 1992-95 Bosnian war and the three decades of international engagement that followed never came close to addressing the causes that led to the conflict.

When Mladic , the former commander of the Bosnian Serb army, died on August 27, 2026 in a prison hospital in The Hague, his conviction for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes — including the 1995 Srebrenica massacre and the siege of Sarajevo — had been final for nearly a decade.

What was never settled, however — and what, it seems, was never even seriously attempted — is the question of how a society lives with a man who remains a convicted criminal in the eyes of an international court but is viewed by some as a hero and symbol of the Serbian people.

For this reason, the reactions that followed Mladic' s death came as no surprise.

In Serbia and the Serb-dominated Republika Srpska , one of the two semi-autonomous entities created within Bosnia-Herzegovina by the 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement, Mladic's death was mourned as the loss of a national hero, not the end of an era of crimes — a narrative that stands in direct contradiction to the facts established by international courts.

Senior officials in Republika Srpska, which covers around 49% of the territory of the former Yugoslav republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina, called on citizens to gather in squares and light candles "for the salvation of the general's soul."

Milorad Dodik , still the most powerful political figure in Republika Srpska despite stepping down as its president last year after a six-year ban on holding public office imposed by Bosnia's constitutional court, called Mladic's death a "murder," suggesting it was "an organized approach that was meant to lead to a fatal outcome."

In Banja Luka, the de facto capital of Republika Srpska, Mayor Drasko Stanivukovic expressed his condolences to Mladic's family and confirmed that Mladic is not perceived as a man convicted of genocide but as a symbol of "a time and a struggle."

Serbia's justice minister announced a funeral with the highest state and military honors.

President Aleksandar Vucic accused the tribunal in The Hague of "uncivilized behavior" for not allowing Mladic to spend his final days outside his prison cell.

Former Interior Minister Aleksandar Vulin spoke of Mladic in the same breath as other Serbian national heroes, invoking a narrative...
body.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并没有结束欧洲历史的黑暗篇章；它重新揭开了旧伤。创造他的意识形态仍然存在。代顿和平协议结束了战争，而不是导致战争的分裂。 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世本应结束欧洲历史上最黑暗的篇章之一。 相反，它重新揭开了旧伤，证明结束 1992-95 年波斯尼亚战争的《代顿协议》和随后三十年的国际接触从未接近解决导致冲突的根源。 当波斯尼亚塞族军队前指挥官姆拉迪奇于 2026 年 8 月 27 日在海牙一家监狱医院去世时，他犯下的种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪——包括 1995 年斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀和萨拉热窝围困——的定罪已经持续了近十年。 然而，从未得到解决——而且似乎从未认真尝试过——的问题是，一个在国际法庭眼中仍然是被定罪的罪犯，但被一些人视为英雄和塞尔维亚人民象征的人，社会如何生活。 因此，姆拉迪奇去世后的反应也就不足为奇了。 在塞尔维亚和塞族统治的塞族共和国（1995年代顿和平协议在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内创建的两个半自治实体之一），姆拉迪奇的去世被视为民族英雄的逝去，而不是一个犯罪时代的结束——这种说法与国际法院确立的事实直接矛盾。 占前南斯拉夫波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国约49%领土的塞族共和国的高级官员呼吁公民聚集在广场上并点燃蜡烛，“以拯救将军的灵魂”。 米洛拉德·多迪克仍然是塞族共和国最有权势的政治人物，尽管去年因波斯尼亚宪法法院禁止担任公职六年而辞去总统职务，他称姆拉迪奇之死是一场“谋杀”，暗示这是“一种有组织的做法，旨在导致致命的结果”。 在塞族共和国事实上的首都巴尼亚卢卡，市长德拉斯科·斯塔尼武科维奇向姆拉迪奇的家人表示哀悼，并确认姆拉迪奇不被视为一个被判犯有种族灭绝罪的人，而是“一个时代和一场斗争”的象征。 塞尔维亚司法部长宣布以最高国家和军事荣誉举行葬礼。 总统亚历山大·武契奇指责海牙法庭“行为不文明”，不允许姆拉迪奇在牢房外度过他的最后几天。 前内政部长亚历山大·武林将姆拉迪奇与其他塞尔维亚民族英雄相提并论，并援引了这样的故事……

reflection.en: The news of Ratko Mladic's death, rather than closing a chapter, has reopened old wounds in Bosnia and Serbia. It underscores how peace agreements can end wars but not the deep divisions that produced them. The hope remains that ultimately, Yahweh will bring an end to conflict and disarm the nations.
reflection.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并未能合上历史的一页，反而重新撕裂了波黑和塞尔维亚的旧伤口。这突显了和平协议可以结束战争，却难以弥合导致冲突的深刻分歧。然而，人们仍怀有盼望，相信雅伟终将平息争战，使列国放下武​​器。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Will Bangladesh join the Mecca defense alliance?
title.zh: 孟加拉国是否会加入麦加防御联盟？

summary.en: Bangladesh is considering the risks associated with signing the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, while experts caution that this move could strain its relationship with neighboring India. Although speculation abounds about Bangladesh joining a mutual defense pact formed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, the South...
summary.zh: 孟加拉国正在权衡签署麦加联合防御协议的风险，专家警告此举可能会使与邻国印度的关系复杂化。尽管外界广泛猜测孟加拉国将加入沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦上个月达成的互助防御协议，但这个南亚国家表示尚未收到邀请。该协议于8月初生效，旨在加强集体威慑，以应对任何侵略行为，并规定对任何一个缔约方的武装袭击将被视为对所有缔约方的袭击...

body.en:
While Bangladesh is weighing the risks of signing the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, experts warn that such a move could complicate relations with neighboring India.

There has been widespread speculation about Bangladesh  becoming part of a mutual defense deal struck last month by Saudi Arabia , Turkey and Pakistan.  But the South Asian country says it has yet to receive an invitation.  

The "Mecca Joint Defense Agreement," ​signed into force in early August, ​is intended to strengthen collective ​deterrence against any act of aggression and stipulates that an ​armed attack against any of the three would be regarded ​as an attack on all.

Some analysts believe the pact has already changed the geopolitical landscape of the Middle East and South Asia. 

"Although it is a collective defense understanding, from a strategic perspective it is primarily an initiative to maintain the regional balance of power and advance the respective interests of the participating states," ​Navine Murshid, professor in the Department of Political Science and Sociology at North South University in Dhaka, told DW.

Any move by Bangladesh to join, however, could complicate its foreign relations, particularly with neighboring India.

The two countries share a 4,096-kilometer-long (2,545 miles) land border, and have strong cultural and economic ties. 

India, a fierce rival of Pakistan, sheltered many Bangladeshi refugees and provided military support to Bangladesh during its independence war against Islamabad in 1971.

However, ties between New Delhi and Dhaka have become increasingly contentious since a deadly student-led uprising in 2024 toppled then Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who was considered a close ally of the Indian government.

Now living in exile in India, Hasina has since been convicted in absentia for crimes against humanity during the uprising . She denies the charges.

Bangladesh's current government, headed by the center-right Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), is in favor of the Mecca agreement.

"We view this pact positively," Bangladeshi Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman said in response to a question in parliament last week.

But he insisted that the question of Bangladesh joining the pact, or even considering membership, had not yet arisen, as that would depend on the intentions of its current members.

"If they express an intention to include Bangladesh in the pact, we will certainly consider it positively," he said. 

In response to a question about such remarks by Bangladeshi officials remarks, India said the pact had implications for its national security and that it was closely monitoring the situation.

"We continue to follow all developments that have a bearing on...
body.zh: 尽管孟加拉国正在权衡签署麦加联合防御协议的风险，但专家警告称，此举可能会使与邻国印度的关系复杂化。 人们普遍猜测孟加拉国将成为沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦上个月达成的共同防御协议的一部分。 但这个南亚国家表示尚未收到邀请。 八月初签署生效的《麦加联合防御协议》旨在加强对任何侵略行为的集体威慑，并规定对三者中任何一个的武装攻击将被视为对所有人的攻击。 一些分析人士认为，该协议已经改变了中东和南亚的地缘政治格局。 达卡南北大学政治学与社会学系教授纳维恩·穆希德 (Navine Murshid) 向德国之声表示：“虽然这是一项集体防御谅解，但从战略角度来看，它主要是维护地区力量平衡和促进参与国各自利益的举措。” 然而，孟加拉国加入的任何举动都可能使其外交关系复杂化，特别是与邻国印度的关系。 两国拥有长达 4,096 公里（2,545 英里）的陆地边界，并拥有牢固的文化和经济联系。 印度是巴基斯坦的激烈竞争对手，在 1971 年孟加拉国针对伊斯兰堡的独立战争期间庇护了许多孟加拉国难民并为其提供了军事支持。 然而，自 2024 年学生领导的致命起义推翻了被视为印度政府亲密盟友的时任孟加拉国总理谢赫·哈西娜以来，新德里和达卡之间的关系变得越来越有争议。 哈西娜现在流亡印度，后来因起义期间危害人类罪被缺席定罪。 她否认这些指控。 以中右翼孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）为首的孟加拉国现任政府支持麦加协议。 “我们积极看待这项协议，”孟加拉国外交部长哈利勒·拉赫曼上周在议会回答问题时表示。 但他坚称，孟加拉国加入该协定，甚至考虑加入该协定的问题尚未出现，因为这将取决于现有成员国的意图。 “如果他们表示有意将孟加拉国纳入该协议，我们肯定会积极考虑，”他说。 在回答有关孟加拉国官员此类言论的问题时，印度表示该协议对其国家安全有影响，并且正在密切关注事态发展。 “我们将继续关注所有影响......的事态发展。

reflection.en: As Bangladesh weighs the decision to join the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, the potential geopolitical ramifications, particularly concerning relations with India, underscore the need for careful deliberation. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that in matters of national policy and complex alliances, "where there is no guidance, a nation falls, but in an abundance...
reflection.zh: 在孟加拉国权衡加入麦加联合防御协议的决定时，潜在的地缘政治影响，特别是与印度的关系，凸显了审慎考虑的必要性。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们，在国家政策和复杂联盟事务中，“不经谋划，民就败落；谋士多，人便得胜。” 寻求多元且明智的咨询对于应对此类敏感的国际决策至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Norway's new King Haakon VIII takes oath in parliament
title.zh: 挪威新国王哈康八世在议会宣誓就职

summary.en: Norway's new King Haakon VIII took his oath of allegiance to the constitution in parliament in Oslo, marking a significant institutional step in his reign. His wife, Queen Mette-Marit, was unable to attend due to her recent lung transplant.
summary.zh: 挪威新国王哈康八世在奥斯陆议会宣誓效忠宪法，这是他统治期间迈出的重要制度性一步。他的妻子梅特-玛丽特王后因近期接受了肺移植手术而未能出席。

body.zh: 新国王在奥斯陆议会宣誓维护宪法，这是他统治时期的第一个重大制度步骤。哈康八世的妻子梅特-玛丽特王后在接受肺移植手术后不得不缺席此次活动。 新国王哈康八世周二在奥斯陆议会宣誓效忠挪威宪法，接替上周去世的父亲哈拉尔五世。 一天前，哈拉尔的灵柩被运往皇宫小教堂，公众将在那里致以最后的敬意，直至 9 月 9 日举行葬礼。 哈康被驱赶到从王宫不远的地方到奥斯陆的议会。 在新立宪君主宣誓之前，众议院议长马苏德·加拉克哈尼宣读了哈拉尔去世和哈康继位的官方公告。 这位 53 岁的老人说：“我保证并发誓，我将根据挪威王国的宪法和法律来治理挪威王国，所以请帮助我，全能、无所不知的上帝。” 在仪式之前，宫殿表示哈康的妻子梅特玛丽特王后不会出席。 这是她自周一担任棺材游行以来首次公开露面，但在六月接受肺移植后正在康复中。 宫殿在一份声明中援引奥斯陆大学医院肺科专家艾尔·霍尔姆的话说，移植后的并发症并不罕见，梅特·玛丽特曾多次经历过这种情况，包括周二。 “因此，女王必须全天接受观察。不幸的是，女王将无法出席今天在议会举行的宣誓就职仪式，”他说。 1905 年，当该国从瑞典手中重新获得独立时，四分之三的选民支持通过公民投票恢复很大程度上具有象征意义的君主立宪制。 大多数政治权力掌握在民选政府和议会手中，但挪威王室在外交和在世界各地推广国家方面仍保留着主要的软实力角色。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The accession of King Haakon VIII brings a new chapter to Norway's monarchy. His oath to uphold the constitution echoes the ancient mandate for rulers to govern with justice and integrity, ensuring the well-being of their people. May his reign be marked by faithful service and a deep commitment to the principles he has sworn to defend.
reflection.zh: 挪威新国王哈康八世的即位为挪威君主制带来了新篇章。他宣誓效忠宪法，这呼应了古代对统治者以公正和诚信治理、确保人民福祉的明确要求。愿他的统治以忠诚的服务和对所誓言维护的原则的坚定承诺为标志。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Israeli-backed ground attack kills three, wounds eight in Gaza
title.zh: 以色列支持的地面袭击造成三人死亡，八人受伤加沙

summary.en: Israel's defense minister said a 'senior Hamas figure' was arrested, but did not give further details. body.en:
Heavy Israeli bombardment killed three people in Gaza City on Tuesday, Palestinian health officials said, in what both sides described as an Israeli-backed ground operation to seize a senior Hamas figure.

Eyewitnesses reported around a dozen strikes on Tuesday morning in western Gaza City, where the territory's civil defence agency said three people were killed, including two children and a woman.

Eight people were wounded, according to the civil defence, which operates as a rescue force under Hamas authority. Gaza City's Al-Shifa Hospital confirmed it had received the bodies and the wounded.

Speaking on the Israeli side of the Gaza border, Defence Minister Israel Katz announced that "a senior Hamas terrorist was arrested" without naming the person or giving further details.

"We do not wait for threats, but hunt down Hamas terrorists, thwart them, and destroy their terror infrastructure," Katz said.

The outspoken minister boasted that due to Israeli strikes since Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, nearly 70 percent of Gaza has been destroyed and under Israeli military control "with no residents, no tunnels, and no houses".

Security sources in Gaza gave a different account, with one telling AFP the Israeli mission against a prominent Hamas figure was thwarted and that special forces withdrew "on motorcycles under Israeli cover".

The forces included an Israeli-allied militia inside Gaza, which Hamas has controlled for years, he said.

Ismail al-Thawabta, head of Hamas's media office in Gaza, said an Israeli special forces operation was "exposed during the mission", prompting heavy airstrikes in the area.

The bombardment also resulted in the "killing of a number of members of the special force that attempted to carry out the mission", Thawabta wrote on X.

The Israeli military said it struck "several targets in the Gaza Strip in order to remove threats to the security forces", without specifying where the strikes took place or giving any further information.

Separately, in the central Gaza Strip, Al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah reported that Israeli fire killed two other people including a girl.

Despite a US-backed ceasefire that took effect in October 2025, violence has not halted in the Gaza Strip, with Israel continuing to target Palestinians it says are militants.

Israeli operations in Gaza have killed at least 1,318 people since the ceasefire came into effect, according to the Palestinian territory's health ministry, which also operates under Hamas authority and whose figures are considered reliable by the United Nations.

reflection.en: The news from Gaza reports the tragic deaths of civilians, including children and a woman, amidst an operation. In times of conflict, the voices of the most vulnerable are often lost. This passage calls us to remember those who cannot speak for themselves and to advocate for justice and protection for all, especially the defenseless.
reflection.zh: 加沙传来的消息令人痛心，报道了在一次行动中包括儿童和妇女在内的平民不幸身亡。在冲突时期，最弱势群体的声音常常被淹没。这段经文呼吁我们铭记那些无法为自己发声的人，并为所有人，特别是手无寸铁者，争取公义和保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.zh: 特朗普吹嘘的与委内瑞拉的“史上最大石油交易”背后是什么？

summary.en: Critics say the deal is the reason the Trump administration captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a raid earlier this year. Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela. Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would...
summary.zh: 批评人士称，这项协议是特朗普政府今年早些时候突袭抓捕委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的原因。有关美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所称的“史上最大石油交易”的细节正在浮出水面。特朗普表示，周六宣布的协议将使美国获得委内瑞拉庞大石油储备的股份，这是他从该国获取能源目标的一步，此前美军于一月份的一次午夜突袭中抓获了时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜...

body.en:
Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela.

Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would give the US a stake in Venezuela's vast oil reserves, a step toward his goal of extracting energy from the country after US forces captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a middle-of-the-night raid in January and brought him to New York to face federal drug trafficking charges.

Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, described the deal as a step toward economic recovery that will modernise the country’s oil industry.

In a televised address to the nation on Sunday, Rodríguez insisted Venezuela's sovereignty is secure and said she wants the country to become a global energy powerhouse.

The US government and a private operator in Venezuela have formed a new company that has been granted rights to access untapped oil fields for 100 years.

A statement from Rodríguez said the deal involves the development of 17 fields with a proven potential of 65 billion barrels.

It said the agreement could draw US$100 billion ($139 billion) in investment into Venezuela's oil industry and yield over US$209 billion ($291 billion) in taxes for the country.

The private operator is North America Blue Energy Partners, owned by Alejandro Betancourt, the White House confirmed on Tuesday.

The company currently produces about 200,000 barrels a day, which makes it the second-largest private operator in Venezuela behind Chevron, according to a source who spoke on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to release the information.

Trump said the agreement was negotiated by US secretary of state Marco Rubio, defence secretary Pete Hegseth and Rodríguez.

The deal will give the US a 35 per cent ownership stake in the company, and the US state department will get a guarantee to buy 20 per cent of the output at cost. US purchases of oil will go towards US strategic oil reserves along with the military, according to a US official who was not authorised to discuss the matter publicly and spoke on the condition of anonymity.

The company would be the second largest corporate holder of proven reserves after Saudi Aramco, according to the US official.

Bob McNally, who was an energy adviser in former US president George W Bush's administration, said the current administration appears to be seeking ways to make it easier for the private sector to invest in Venezuela's industry through the deal.

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

title.en: Three decades after Tupac's death, a jury has reached a verdict
title.zh: 图帕克去世三十年后，陪审团做出裁决

summary.en: A Las Vegas jury found an ex-gang leader guilty of murder on Tuesday in a case accusing him of plotting the drive-by killing of legendary hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, bringing a decades-old cold case to a close. Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was charged with murder using a deadly weapon and accused of leading a group to...
summary.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯一个陪审团裁定一名退休帮派头目谋杀罪名成立，该案指控他策划了传奇嘻哈艺术家图帕克·夏库尔（Tupac Shakur）的驾车枪杀案，从而了结了一桩尘封数十年的悬案。63岁的杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）被控一项使用致命武器谋杀罪，并被指控策划了一群人杀害了图帕克，以报复其侄子被打一事。

body.en:
A Las Vegas jury found an ex-gang leader guilty of murder on Tuesday in a case accusing him of plotting the drive-by killing of legendary hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, bringing a decades-old cold case to a close.

Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was charged in Nevada's Clark County with a single count of murder using a deadly weapon. He had pleaded not guilty.

Davis was accused of leading a group of men to kill Shakur, who was one of rap's most commercially successful and influential artists, in retaliation for the beating of Davis' nephew.

Police had said they long suspected Davis but did not have enough evidence to charge him until he went public with his story in media appearances and a memoir, which, along with tapes of his secret meetings with investigators, made up the bulk of the prosecution’s case.

Davis' lawyer said his client's words were mere bravado and could not be corroborated by other evidence.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The trial began on 17 August. Prosecutors played hours of recorded conversations in which Davis said he was enraged after Shakur and his entourage beat up Davis’ nephew at a Las Vegas casino on 7 September 1996.

Davis and three other men, including his nephew, went looking for Shakur and record label executive Marion "Suge" Knight in a white Cadillac on the night of the beating, he said. Davis said he passed a gun to the backseat, and when they found Knight and Shakur’s car, one of the two men in the back opened fire.

Prosecutors have not named the shooter, and the three other men who were in the car have since died. Under Nevada law, Davis can be charged with murder even though he did not pull the trigger.

Davis was a leader of the Southside Compton Crips, a Los Angeles-area street gang that feuded with rival gang Mob Piru, which was associated with Shakur and his record label Death Row Records.

Shakur's killing in 1996 became a seminal moment in rap history and heightened hip-hop culture's violent image during 'gangsta' rap's heyday, an era defined by feuding between East and West Coast artists.

body.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯陪审团裁定一名前帮派头目犯有谋杀罪，指控他密谋驾车杀害传奇嘻哈艺术家图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur)，从而结束了这起长达数十年的悬案。 63 岁的杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane "Keffe D" Davis) 在内华达州克拉克县被指控犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪。他不认罪。 戴维斯被指控带领一群人杀害沙库尔，沙库尔是说唱界在商业上最成功和最有影响力的艺术家之一，以报复殴打戴维斯的侄子。 警方表示，他们长期以来一直怀疑戴维斯，但没有足够的证据来指控他，直到他在媒体上公开自己的故事和一本回忆录，其中加上他与调查人员秘密会面的录音，构成了检方案件的大部分。 戴维斯的律师表示，他当事人的言论只是虚张声势，无法得到其他证据的证实。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 审判于8月17日开始。检察官播放了数小时的对话录音，戴维斯表示，1996 年 9 月 7 日，沙库尔及其随行人员在拉斯维加斯赌场殴打戴维斯的侄子后，他感到非常愤怒。 戴维斯说，在遭到殴打的当晚，戴维斯和包括他侄子在内的另外三名男子开着一辆白色凯迪拉克去寻找沙库尔和唱片公司高管马里昂·“苏格”·奈特。戴维斯说，他把枪递到后座，当他们发现奈特和沙库尔的车时，后座的两名男子中的一个开枪了。 检察官尚未透露枪手的姓名，车内的其他三名男子现已死亡。根据内华达州法律，即使戴维斯没有扣动扳机，也可以被指控谋杀。 戴维斯是洛杉矶地区街头帮派南区康普顿克里普斯 (Southside Compton Crips) 的头目，该帮派与竞争对手帮派 Mob Piru 不和，后者与沙库尔及其唱片公司 Death Row Records 有联系。 1996 年 Shakur 被杀成为说唱史上的一个重要时刻，并提升了嘻哈文化在“黑帮”说唱全盛时期的暴力形象，这个时代的特点是东海岸和西海岸艺术家之间的不和。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: After three decades, justice has been served for the murder of Tupac Shakur. The conviction of Duane "Keffe D" Davis stems from a plot to retaliate for a prior assault. This case highlights how cycles of violence, born from a desire for revenge, can ensnare individuals and communities for generations. May we seek to overcome evil with good, breaking these...
reflection.zh: 三十年后，图帕克·夏库尔（Tupac Shakur）的谋杀案终于得到了审判。杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）的定罪源于一次报复性的杀人计划。此案凸显了复仇心驱使下的暴力循环如何能世世代代地困住个人和社群。愿我们寻求以善胜恶，打破这些毁灭性的模式。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet floods: millions at risk from glacial floods in Himalayas in years to come, UN warns, as death toll passes 1,000 – latest updates
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：死亡人数超过1000人，救援工作仍在水电站隧道进行——最新消息

summary.en: The death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 1,000, with approximately 4,500 people missing. Hundreds of unidentified victims have reportedly been buried as morgues were overwhelmed. Rescue efforts continue, but hopes are fading for those trapped in mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区灾难性的洪水造成的死亡人数已超过1000人，约有4500人失踪。据报道，由于太平间不堪重负，数百名身份不明的遇难者已被埋葬。救援工作仍在继续，但被困在水电站泥泞隧道中的失踪人员获救的希望渺茫。

body.en: ‘Technology cannot move fast enough to prevent loss’, official says, as rescue efforts for the 4,500 still missing continue Nepal last week turned down foreign ​involvement in general search and rescue but said it needed specialised services and advanced technological support in areas such as life-detecting machines, large refrigerators and pre-fabricated bridges. Aid worth more than $42m has poured into the country and Nepal is now working with experts from other countries to help with rescue operations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 官员称，截至周二上午，尼泊尔和中国发生的特大洪水造成的死亡人数已超过 1,000 人，据报道，洪水淹没了太平间，当局正在埋葬数百名身份不明的遇难者。 尼泊尔救灾机构在周二发布的最新消息中称，该国已统计出 987 人死亡、3,916 人失踪，其中包括 583 名外国人。 中国当局在周日发布的最新消息中称，已有 16 人死亡、546 人失踪。 灾难发生后的最初 72 小时被视为对救援行动至关重要，而找到失踪人员生还的希望也越来越渺茫。 尽管如此，救援工作仍在继续，但由于地形复杂、洪水持续高涨和恶劣的天气而变得复杂。 上周三发生了毁灭性的洪水，当时喜马拉雅山的一大片冰川松动，坠落到尼泊尔朗唐国家公园的谷底，释放出一道巨大的水墙和泥浆，冲入河流和山谷。 由此引发的洪水摧毁了村庄并摧毁了发电站、道路和桥梁等重要基础设施。 目前，救援工作主要集中在寻找大约 900 名失踪的水电工人，其中数百人可能被困在尼泊尔 12 个水电项目的隧道和地下区域中。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周一对路透社表示：“大量碎片已经堆积起来，这给我们打开隧道带来了巨大挑战。” 正如我的同事在这篇报道中指出的那样，上特里苏里水电站项目周末约有 250 人获救，陆军工程师开始在现场进行爆破作业，营救另外 42 名被认为失踪的工人。 担心许多人仍然被困在流经尼泊尔中部的特里苏里河沿岸水电站的庞大泥浆隧道网络中。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense loss, with over a thousand lives tragically ended and thousands more missing. In the face of such profound grief and destruction, we look to the promise of a future where suffering and death will be no more. May Yahweh comfort those who mourn and grant them His peace.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区毁灭性的洪水带来了巨大的损失，超过一千条生命不幸终结，另有数千人失踪。面对如此深切的悲痛和毁灭，我们寄望于一个不再有痛苦和死亡的未来。愿雅伟安慰那些哀恸的人，并赐予他们平安。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Meet the magical creatures inspired by shamanism, folklore … and an old Ikea bag
title.zh: 遇见受萨满教、民间传说……和旧宜家袋启发的魔法生物

summary.en: Korean-Chinese artist Woo Jin Joo uses London's discarded materials to create playful art, including ceramic goblin feet and furry disembodied legs, drawing inspiration from Korean myths, philosophy, and embroidery.
summary.zh: 韩裔中国艺术家Woo Jin Joo利用伦敦的废弃材料创作充满玩趣的艺术品，包括陶瓷哥布林脚和毛茸茸的无肢腿，其灵感来源于韩国神话、哲学和刺绣。

body.en: From ceramic goblin feet to furry disembodied legs, Korean-Chinese artist Woo Jin Joo is using London junk to inject the art world with a spirit of playfulness Woo Jin Joo’s studio is full of magic. Ceramic green goblin feet line the windowsill, disembodied furry legs jut out of one white wall and, on the table behind where the Korean-Chinese artist sits drinking tea, a headless being dressed in a black coat squats, arms aloft in warning. There are also neat racks of colourful thread next to a freehand embroidery machine, the source of this supernatural hoard. This is where Joo creates much of her art – surface embroideries and sculptural 3D creatures inspired by Korean myth, philosophy and the relationship between humans and the natural world. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从陶瓷妖精脚到毛茸茸的无实体腿，韩裔中国艺术家吴金珠利用伦敦垃圾为艺术世界注入了一种俏皮的精神。吴金珠的工作室充满了魔力。窗台上排列着绿色的陶瓷脚，毛茸茸的腿从白墙上伸出来，韩裔中国艺术家坐在后面喝茶的桌子上，蹲着一个穿着黑色外套的无头人，高举双臂发出警告。徒手刺绣机旁边还有整齐的彩色线架，这是这些超自然宝藏的来源。这是 Joo 创作大部分艺术作品的地方——表面刺绣和雕塑 3D 生物，其灵感来自韩国神话、哲学以及人类与自然世界的关系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Woo Jin Joo transforms discarded items into whimsical creatures, infusing her art with spirit and playfulness. Her dedication to her craft, whether through embroidery or sculpture, echoes the call to do all work heartily, as for Yahweh, finding dignity and purpose in the act of creation itself. This artistic endeavor reminds us that even in the mundane or...
reflection.zh: Woo Jin Joo将废弃物品转化为异想天开的生物，为她的艺术注入精神和玩趣。她对工艺的投入，无论是刺绣还是雕塑，都呼应着要全心全意地去做一切工作，如同为主而做，在创造本身的行为中找到尊严和目标。 这项艺术事业提醒我们，即使在平凡或被丢弃的事物中，也蕴藏着美丽和意义的潜力。通过将精力倾注于改造这些材料，Woo Jin...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: As glaciers melt, can communities be protected?
title.zh: 冰川融化，社区能否得到保护？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 气温上升增加了山区洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案，以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士巴滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，当时几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪爆发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员 Levan Tielidze 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩石斜坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯联邦北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪崩塌和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽告诉德国之声：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（36 华氏度），与 2020 年的水平相比，更广泛的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖面积可能会减少多达一半……

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of creation groaning under the weight of climate change. Glaciers, formed over millennia, are becoming unstable, leading to devastating 'mountain tsunamis.' This echoes Romans 8:22, which speaks of all creation groaning in the pains of childbirth, awaiting its redemption from decay. The urgent need for...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的景象：在气候变化的重压下，受造界发出痛苦的呻吟。历经千年形成的冰川正变得不稳定，导致毁灭性的“山洪海啸”。这呼应了罗马书8:22所说，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着从败坏中得释放。对解决方案的迫切需求，凸显了我们共同的责任，要关爱这个脆弱的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 1,000 as police ask relatives for DNA to identify victims
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水死亡人数超过1000人，警方要求亲属提供DNA以识别遇难者

summary.en: Relatives of missing tourists were asked for blood samples and photos as rescue efforts continued for hundreds of hydropower workers trapped in the Himalayas. The death toll from devastating floods has surpassed 1,000 nearly a week after the disaster struck towns and valleys across Nepal and Tibet.
summary.zh: 在喜马拉雅山区搜救数百名被困水电站工人的同时，失踪游客的亲属被要求提供血样和照片。在毁灭性洪水袭击尼泊尔和西藏的城镇和山谷近一周后，死亡人数已超过1000人。

body.en: Relatives of missing tourists asked for blood samples and photos, as efforts continue to rescue trapped hydropower workers Nepal-Tibet floods – latest updates Visual guide: How the Nepal-Tibet flash flood unfolded Nepali rescuers have built temporary bridges to reach remote areas and dug through the ruins of hydropower projects in the Himalayas to rescue hundreds of trapped workers, as the death toll passed 1,000 nearly ⁠a week after devastating ​floods left a trail of destruction across the country’s towns and valleys. About 600 people remain stuck in several devastated hydropower stations that have become the focus of rescue efforts. The prime ⁠minister, Balendra Shah, said more than 11,000 people had been rescued across the affected region, and power and communication lines had been restored in some areas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 失踪游客的亲属要求提供血样和照片，同时继续努力营救被困的水电工人。 尼泊尔-西藏洪水——最新动态 视觉指南：尼泊尔-西藏山洪爆发的过程 尼泊尔救援人员建造了临时桥梁，到达偏远地区，并在喜马拉雅山的水电项目废墟中挖掘，以营救数百名被困工人。毁灭性洪水在该国城镇造成严重破坏，近一周后死亡人数已超过 1,000 人。和山谷。几个被毁的水电站仍有约600人被困，这些水电站已成为救援工作的重点。总理巴伦德拉·沙阿 (Balendra Shah) 表示，受影响地区已有 11,000 多人获救，部分地区的电力和通讯线路已恢复。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, leaving a trail of destruction and immense grief. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, 'Jesus wept,' speaks volumes. It shows that divine empathy is present even in our deepest sorrow, acknowledging the pain without offering easy answers.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的洪水已造成1000多人死亡，留下了满目疮痍和巨大的悲痛。在如此深切的失落时刻，圣经中最短的一节经文“耶稣哭了”意义深远。它表明，即使在我们最深的悲伤中，神圣的同情也与我们同在，承认痛苦，却不提供廉价的慰藉。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Nepal death toll crosses 1,000 as rescuers race to find workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels
title.zh: 尼泊尔救援人员炸开山坡搜寻水电工人，家属焦急等待

summary.en: Rescuers are using explosives in a desperate attempt to reach workers trapped in tunnels following severe flooding in Nepal. The death toll from the disaster has risen to 939, with over 600 workers feared missing.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔发生严重洪灾后，救援人员正使用炸药绝望地试图接触被困在隧道中的工人。此次灾难的死亡人数已升至939人，另有超过600名工人据信失踪。

body.en:
The death toll in Nepal from devastating floods on the border with Tibet has crossed 1,000, according to the country's disaster agency.

More than 3,900 people remain missing - of whom more than 600 are workers believed to be trapped in a vast network of mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites along Trishuli River.

Engineers have been pumping air into the tunnels - and while a team did manage to gain entry to one of them, it withdrew after finding no-one there.

"I wish we could find him. I wish he would come home," Anushila Bhandari, wife of Aurus Bhandari, a 33-year-old engineer missing on a project site, told BBC Nepali.

Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Monday that 279 people had been rescued from the sites.

The rescue operation is being spearheaded by an international team made up of Chinese and Nepalese military personnel, while experts from India, Korea and Australia are also involved.

"I still have a 50% hope that he is alive because there is an oxygen system inside," Sita Pandey, whose husband was working in the plant when the floods hit, told Nepalese daily Kantipur.

Nepal relies heavily on hydropower and has spent years developing the projects along its mountainous river systems. At least 11 projects either completed or under construction were damaged in the floods, authorities said.

Rescuers began pumping air into a tunnel over the weekend, but the families of those trapped say that should have been done earlier.

A team was able to get into a tunnel leading to one hydropower plant earlier on Monday, but retreated after no one was found there.

"The longer it takes, the more our hope dies. This operation must move much faster because every second is meaningful to us," Jiban Khadka, whose relative is also trapped inside the plant, told Kantipur.

Rescue operations had been "intensified", Nepalese leader Shah said, noting that the floods were "not an ordinary" event.

"This incident indicates that the risks we face in the Himalayan region are increasing alongside climate change.

"It is now time for us to strongly raise with the international community the issue of the disasters we are experiencing as a result of climate change," Shah wrote in a Facebook post late on Monday.

Another family member anxiously awaiting news is Priya Kharel, whose brother Milan was working as an engineer in the Upper Trishuli-1 plant when the floods hit.

"Those who returned from the hydropower site said there were people inside the tunnel," she told BBC News Nepali. "So there is hope that if the army reaches them quickly, they can be saved."

Australian engineer Arnold Dix, who has been helping Nepalese authorities with the underground search operations remotely, said rescuers had been struggling to find the tunnels.
