title.en: Peacemaker program linked to 61% decline in gun violence deaths and injuries
title.zh: “和平缔造者”计划与枪支暴力死亡和伤害减少61%相关

summary.en: A new study published in JAMA Network Open indicates that Richmond, California's Office of Neighborhood Safety (ONS) program, known as 'Peacemaker,' has been linked to a 61% decrease in firearm homicides and injury shootings over the last 14 years. This community violence intervention program is one of the few studied...
summary.zh: 发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的一项新研究表明，加利福尼亚州里士满市的“邻里安全办公室”（ONS）计划，即“和平缔造者”计划，在过去14年中与该市枪支凶杀案和枪击伤亡事件减少61%相关。该社区暴力干预计划是全国少数几个被研究的、对城市枪支暴力产生十年以上持续影响的计划之一。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new study by researchers at UC Berkeley's Center for Global Healthy Cities, published in JAMA Network Open , found that the California city of Richmond's Office of Neighborhood Safety (ONS) was responsible for a 61% reduction in the city's firearm homicides and injury shootings over the past 14 years.

This is one of the only studies in the country to document the sustained impact of a community violence intervention (CVI) program on citywide firearm violence over more than 10 years.

According to lead author Alice Bruno, a doctoral student in epidemiology at UC Berkeley's School of Public Health, "We leveraged data from dozens of comparable cities across the United States to estimate what firearm violence would have looked like in Richmond without the ONS Peacemaker Fellowship. We found that the Fellowship contributed to long-term reductions in violence, and that the declines only grew as the program operated."

Other UC Berkeley co-authors include Dr. Jason Corburn; Dr. Mahasin Mujahid, chair of the Division of Epidemiology; Dr. Sean Darling-Hammond; and Dr. Juan Cabrera.

Sam Vaughn, director of ONS, said, "The statistics back up what we have seen in the streets: fewer shootings, fewer deaths and a healthier community overall."

Homicide rates are down across the country; the FBI recently released data showing murder rates are down a record 18.1% nationally. However, Richmond has consistently outperformed national declines for more than a decade, suggesting the results are due to the city's innovative street outreach interventions and mentorship of active firearm offenders.

The program, called Operation Peacemaker Fellowship, was instituted in 2010. The Fellowship uses a public health approach to preventing gun violence .

According to James Houston, program manager of the ONS, who oversees the day-to-day implementation of the Peacemaker Fellowship, including managing 14 street outreach workers who currently serve 123 participants, "The credit goes to the young people making better decisions and the team that gives them support, mentorship and encouragement every day to make a change."

According to Shasa Curl, Richmond city manager, Richmond had more than 300 police officers FTE in 2014 and 180 in 2020 but was down to 121 active sworn officers by 2024. Yet during this time, the ONS, through continued city support and grants, was able to expand its staff and increase the number of fellows and participants.

Even during the COVID-19 period, the study shows Richmond did not have as significant a spike in firearm violence as most cities across the Bay Area and...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 加州大学伯克利分校全球健康城市中心的研究人员在《美国医学会杂志》网络公开版上发表的一项新研究发现，过去 14 年来，加州里士满市的社区安全办公室 (ONS) 使该市的枪支杀人和伤害枪击事件减少了 61%。 这是该国唯一记录十多年来社区暴力干预 (CVI) 计划对全市枪支暴力持续影响的研究之一。 主要作者、加州大学伯克利分校公共卫生学院流行病学博士生爱丽丝·布鲁诺 (Alice Bruno) 表示，“我们利用美国数十个类似城市的数据来估计，如果没有国家统计局和平缔造者奖学金，里士满的枪支暴力会是什么样子。我们发现，该奖学金有助于长期减少暴力，而且随着该项目的实施，暴力的下降只会进一步加剧。” 加州大学伯克利分校的其他合著者包括 Jason Corburn 博士； Mahasin Mujahid 博士，流行病学部主任；肖恩·达林-哈蒙德博士；和胡安·卡布雷拉博士。 英国国家统计局局长萨姆·沃恩表示：“统计数据支持了我们在街头看到的情况：枪击事件减少，死亡人数减少，社区整体更加健康。” 全国凶杀率下降； FBI 最近发布的数据显示，全国谋杀率下降了 18.1%，创历史新高。然而，十多年来，里士满的表现一直好于全国的下滑，这表明这一结果归功于该市创新的街头外展干预措施和对活跃枪支犯罪者的指导。 该计划名为“和平缔造者行动奖学金”，于 2010 年设立。该奖学金采用公共卫生方法来预防枪支暴力。 英国国家统计局 (ONS) 项目经理詹姆斯·休斯顿 (James Houston) 负责监督和平缔造者奖学金的日常实施，包括管理目前为 123 名参与者提供服务的 14 名街头外展工作人员，他表示，“这要归功于年轻人做出更好的决策，以及每天为他们提供支持、指导和鼓励以做出改变的团队。” 里士满市经理 Shasa Curl 表示，里士满 2014 年有超过 300 名全职警察，2020 年有 180 名全职警察，但到 2024 年，现役宣誓警察人数减少到 121 名。然而，在此期间，国家统计局通过持续的市政府支持和拨款，能够扩大其人员规模并增加研究员和参与者的数量。 即使在 COVID-19 期间，研究显示里士满的枪支暴力也没有像湾区和其他大多数城市那样大幅增加。

reflection.en: The beatitude 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of Yahweh' finds a tangible echo in Richmond, California. The 'Peacemaker' program's success in reducing gun violence demonstrates how focused, community-led efforts can foster a more peaceful environment, reflecting a divine calling to actively build peace.
reflection.zh: “使人和睦的人有福了！因为人要称他们为神的儿子。”（马太福音 5:9）这句教诲在加利福尼亚州里士满市得到了切实的体现。‘和平缔造者’计划在减少枪支暴力方面的成功，证明了有针对性的社区主导的努力能够促进更和平的环境，这反映了神圣的使命——积极地建立和平。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Trawling threatens vital carbon stores in Scotland's sea lochs
title.zh: 拖网捕捞威胁苏格兰海湾的重要碳储存

summary.en: New research from the University of St Andrews indicates that disturbing seabed sediments through trawling in Scotland's sea lochs could lead to significant losses of stored carbon. This disturbance releases organic carbon into the seawater, which can then break down and return to the atmosphere as carbon dioxide,...
summary.zh: 圣安德鲁斯大学的最新研究表明，在苏格兰海湾通过拖网捕捞扰动海底沉积物，可能导致储存的碳大量流失。这种扰动会将有机碳释放到海水中，然后分解并以二氧化碳的形式返回大气，加剧气候变化。

body.en: New research from the University of St Andrews shows that disturbing seabed sediments through trawling could cause significant losses of carbon stored in Scotland's sea lochs. The study, published in Marine Environmental Research, shows that organic carbon stored in seabed sediments can be released into the surrounding seawater when disturbed. This carbon is then more likely to be broken down and ultimately returned to the atmosphere as carbon dioxide, contributing to climate change.
body.zh: 圣安德鲁斯大学的新研究表明，通过拖网捕捞扰乱海底沉积物可能会导致苏格兰海域储存的碳大量流失。这项发表在《海洋环境研究》上的研究表明，海底沉积物中储存的有机碳在受到干扰时会释放到周围的海水中。这些碳更有可能被分解并最终以二氧化碳的形式返回大气中，从而导致气候变化。

reflection.en: The deep sea holds vast stores of carbon, a vital part of our planet's delicate balance. When human activity like trawling disrupts these ancient reserves, the consequences ripple outwards, impacting the climate for all. This reminds us that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh, and we are called to be faithful stewards of His creation.
reflection.zh: 深海蕴藏着大量的碳，这是我们星球脆弱平衡的重要组成部分。当拖网捕捞等人类活动扰乱这些古老的储备时，其后果会向外扩散，影响到所有人的气候。这提醒我们，地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟，我们被呼召成为祂创造物忠实的管家。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Marmite lures discovery from lake depths
title.zh: 马麦酱引出湖泊深处的发现

summary.en: Dr. Roe Stuart, while exploring the unexplored depths of New Zealand's lakes, did not find a mythical taniwha but may have discovered a new species of fish.
summary.zh: 罗伊·斯图尔特博士在探索新西兰湖泊未知的深处时，并未找到神话中的塔尼瓦，却可能发现了一个新的鱼类物种。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Dr. Roe Stuart didn't find a taniwha in the unexplored depths of New Zealand's lakes—but they may have found a new species of fish.

"We have four lakes in New Zealand that exceed 400m (1,300 feet) deep, and the deepest records we had of fish life were 90m (300 feet)," says Stuart, who realized while doing postdoctoral work at Lake Champlain in the U.S. that no one knew what lurked in Aotearoa's lakes.

A depth sounder found Lake Manapōuri and Lake Te Anau to be 467m (1,532 feet) and 430m (1,411 feet) deep, respectively—about the height of Dunedin's Saddle Hill.

Searching for signs of aquatic life in the unexplored waters required 2km (1.2 miles) of rope, multiple traps set at different depths and ... a breakfast spread?

"We baited the traps with Marmite," Stuart says. "I've had quite a few people ask if Vegemite also works, but why risk it?"

When the team returned the next day, they pulled up the traps that had been set at different depths—and found fish in all of them.

"There's fish in here!" Stuart exclaims, reliving the moment of discovery. "It's not very often that you get to have that 'we're the only people that know this' moment."

Stuart found native bullies and galaxiids—small (about 12cm [4.7 inches]), iridescent climbing fish that are sometimes caught as whitebait.

"They're very different from our standard assumption of what a kōaro is, so they're either an adaptation or a new species."

"Their eyes are huge compared to regular kōaro, and the other really cool thing about them is that they have these amazingly large sensory pores on the top of their heads. There's no light down at the bottom of the lakes, and the sensory pores likely help them navigate their habitat."

Genetic testing will determine whether the fish are indeed a new species, but Stuart is thrilled to have found life in the lake depths at all.

"No one's worked in New Zealand's deep lakes before, and everyone I talked to was somewhat skeptical I might find anything—so the fact we found fish in both lakes was hugely exciting. It's hard to protect and care about something if you don't know it exists."

"The fact the lakes have oxygen all the way down is informative in itself," Stuart says.

"It brings in questions about the human impacts on the surface. We don't necessarily think about those really deep basins, so how our impacts transfer is something we should consider for future management of these iconic, deep-water lakes."

Finding hidden fish is a change of pace for Stuart, who's used to chasing aquatic life around the lab.

"I did a postdoc at the University of Vermont, looking at...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 罗伊·斯图尔特博士在新西兰未开发的湖泊深处并没有发现塔尼瓦鱼，但他们可能发现了一种新的鱼类。 “新西兰有四个湖泊深度超过 400m（1,300 英尺），而我们对鱼类生活的最深记录为 90m（300 英尺）”，Stuart 说。他在美国尚普兰湖做博士后工作时意识到，没有人知道奥特亚罗瓦湖泊中潜藏着什么。 测深仪发现马纳波里湖和蒂阿瑙湖分别深 467 m（1,532 英尺）和 430 m（1,411 英尺），大约与达尼丁马鞍山的高度相当。 在未开发的水域中寻找水生生物的迹象需要 2 公里（1.2 英里）的绳索、在不同深度设置的多个陷阱以及……一份早餐？ “我们用马麦酱作为诱饵，”斯图尔特说。 “很多人问 Vegemite 是否也有效，但为什么要冒险呢？” 第二天，当团队返回时，他们拉开了设置在不同深度的陷阱，并在所有陷阱中发现了鱼。 “这里有鱼！”斯图尔特惊叹道，重温了发现的那一刻。 “你很少会遇到‘我们是唯一知道这一点的人’的时刻。” 斯图尔特发现了本地的霸王鱼和银河鱼，它们是体型较小（约 12 厘米（4.7 英寸））、呈彩虹色的攀爬鱼，有时会作为银鱼被捕获。 “它们与我们对科阿罗的标准假设有很大不同，因此它们要么是适应物种，要么是新物种。” “与普通的科阿罗相比，它们的眼睛很大，而且它们的另一个很酷的事情是它们的头顶上有这些令人惊讶的大感觉孔。湖底没有光，感觉孔可能帮助它们在栖息地中导航。” 基因测试将确定这些鱼是否确实是一个新物种，但斯图尔特很高兴在湖深处发现了生命。 “以前没有人在新西兰的深湖中工作过，与我交谈过的每个人都有点怀疑我是否能找到任何东西，所以我们在两个湖中发现鱼的事实非常令人兴奋。如果你不知道某些东西的存在，就很难保护和关心它。” “事实上，湖泊自始至终都有氧气，这本身就提供了丰富的信息，”斯图尔特说。 “它带来了关于人类对地表影响的问题。我们不一定会考虑那些真正深的盆地，所以我们的影响如何转移是我们在未来管理这些标志性深水湖泊时应该考虑的问题。” 对于习惯在实验室里追逐水生生物的斯图尔特来说，寻找隐藏的鱼是他生活节奏的改变。 “我在佛蒙特大学做了博士后，研究......

reflection.en: The deep, dark waters of New Zealand's lakes have yielded a potential new species of fish, a testament to the hidden wonders within creation. This discovery reminds us that even in the most inaccessible places, Yahweh's intricate design is at work, waiting to be uncovered by patient observation and curiosity.
reflection.zh: 新西兰湖泊深邃幽暗的水域可能孕育了一个新的鱼类物种，这证明了受造界中隐藏的奇妙。这一发现提醒我们，即使在最难以到达的地方，雅伟精妙的设计也在运作，等待着有耐心的观察和好奇心去揭示。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - podcast
title.zh: 咔哒声、咕哝声和尖叫声：鲸鱼交流的奇迹——播客

summary.en: Since the earliest recording of whale song in 1949, scientists have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. Advances in technology are enabling researchers to decode these intricate patterns, which could lead to better whale protection from human-caused threats.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，科学家们一直被它们复杂的发声方式所吸引。技术的进步使研究人员能够解码这些复杂的模式，这可能有助于更好地保护鲸鱼免受人类的威胁。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Copyright 1978 National Geographic Society and 1977 Capitol Records, Inc. body.zh: 自从 1949 年录制了已知最早的鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员就一直被它们交流时的哀号、隆隆声、咔哒声、咕噜声和尖叫声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译使不同物种的发声与众不同的复杂模式。马德琳·芬利听到艾玛·布莱斯的来信，她是一名记者，花了几个月的时间调查人类理解鲸鱼歌曲的努力。她解释了这些知识如何帮助我们更好地保护鲸鱼免受人为伤害。鸣谢： 1. 版权所有 1978 年国家地理学会和 1977 年 Capitol Records, Inc。Roger Payne 博士评论 2. reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and for decades, humans have strained to understand the complex language of whales. As technology allows us to decipher their clicks and songs, we gain not only knowledge but also a deeper appreciation for the intricate life Yahweh has woven into creation. This pursuit of understanding reminds us that wisdom is often found by...
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，几十年来，人类一直努力理解鲸鱼复杂的语言。随着技术使我们能够破译它们的咔哒声和歌声，我们不仅获得了知识，还对雅伟编织到造物中的复杂生命有了更深的欣赏。这种理解的追求提醒我们，智慧往往是通过观察我们周围的世界来获得的，而这个世界充满了雅伟多样的艺术。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: More hosepipe bans in force as drought declared - is your area affected?
title.zh: 因干旱宣布更多限水令，你所在的地区受影响了吗？

summary.en: Approximately 30 million people are now subject to hosepipe bans due to increased water demand and insufficient rainfall. Both England and Wales experienced their driest July on record, with prolonged heatwaves straining water resources and impacting rivers, crops, and wildlife.
summary.zh: 由于用水需求增加和降雨不足，约有3000万人受到限水令的影响。英格兰和威尔士都经历了创纪录的最干旱的七月，持续的热浪使供水紧张，并影响了河流、农作物和野生动植物。

body.en:
Nearly three-quarters of England and all of Wales are under drought conditions, with repeated heatwaves leaving water supplies under strain.

Both England and Wales provisionally recorded their driest July on record. This lack of rainfall - on top of hot, dry weather in spring and early summer - has taken its toll on rivers, crops and nature.

Roughly 30 million people across parts of England and Wales are now covered by hosepipe bans.

There is no single definition of drought, but it is characterised by a period of low rainfall. As the ground dries out, crops and vegetation can begin to struggle.

If dry conditions persist, rivers, reservoirs and groundwater levels can also fall, putting pressure on water supplies.

Environmental bodies in each UK nation decide whether to declare drought or water scarcity by assessing current water resources alongside weather forecasts.

Both drought and water scarcity can lead to hosepipe bans, if they are not already in place.

While drought is driven by prolonged dry weather, water scarcity occurs when demand for water outstrips the available supply. This summer, restrictions have been introduced in some areas to help manage high demand.

But while recent months have seen temperatures regularly exceed 35C, winter was much wetter than usual.

It has raised questions about how effectively water resources are being managed, and whether the UK is prepared for the drier summers expected with climate change.

So far, 11 UK water companies have announced hosepipe bans. This means hosepipes cannot be used for watering gardens, washing vehicles and windows, and filling pools.

Ten companies are spread across central, southern and eastern parts of England, and one is in Wales.

In England, nearly three-quarters of the country is now in drought, according to the Environment Agency (EA). Northern parts of England are in "prolonged dry weather" - the category below drought.

Elsewhere, the whole of Wales is in drought, with Natural Resources Wales saying sustained high temperatures were causing the condition of the natural environment to "deteriorate".

While conditions have improved in some parts of Scotland following recent rainfall, some areas remain in the two most extreme categories of "moderate" or "significant" scarcity, according to the Scottish Environment Protection Agency.

Our three main sources of water are rivers, reservoirs and from deep underground.

Almost all river flows in England and Wales were classed as "below normal", "notably low" or "exceptionally low" in July, according to the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (UKCEH).

"This is the third time in the last five years that drought conditions have intensified rapidly following exceptional spring and summer dryness," said Steve Turner, a hydrologist at...
body.zh: 英格兰近四分之三的地区和威尔士全境都处于干旱状态，反复出现的热浪导致供水紧张。 英格兰和威尔士都暂时录得有记录以来最干燥的七月。除了春季和初夏炎热干燥的天气之外，降雨量的缺乏也对河流、农作物和自然造成了损害。 目前，英格兰和威尔士部分地区约有 3000 万人受到软管禁令的保护。 干旱没有单一的定义，但其特点是降雨量少的时期。当地面干燥时，农作物和植被就会开始生长。 如果干旱持续存在，河流、水库和地下水位也会下降，给供水带来压力。 英国每个国家的环境机构通过评估当前水资源和天气预报来决定是否宣布干旱或缺水。 如果尚未实施的话，干旱和缺水都可能导致软管禁令。 虽然干旱是由长期干旱天气造成的，但当水需求超过可用供应时，就会出现缺水。今年夏天，一些地区出台了限制措施，以帮助应对高需求。 不过，尽管最近几个月气温经常超过 35 摄氏度，但冬季却比平时潮湿得多。 它引发了人们对水资源管理效率的质疑，以及英国是否为气候变化带来的干燥夏季做好准备。 迄今为止，已有 11 家英国自来水公司宣布禁止使用软管。这意味着软管不能用于浇灌花园、清洗车辆和窗户以及给水池注水。 十家公司分布在英格兰中部、南部和东部地区，其中一家位于威尔士。 据环境署 (EA) 称，在英格兰，该国近四分之三的地区目前正处于干旱之中。英格兰北部地区正处于“长期干旱天气”——低于干旱的类别。 在其他地方，整个威尔士都处于干旱状态，威尔士自然资源部表示，持续的高温导致自然环境状况“恶化”。 苏格兰环境保护局表示，尽管近期降雨后苏格兰部分地区的情况有所改善，但一些地区仍处于“中度”或“严重”稀缺的两个最极端类别。 我们的三大水源是河流、水库和地下深处。 根据英国生态与水文中心 (UKCEH) 的数据，7 月份英格兰和威尔士几乎所有河流的流量都被列为“低于正常水平”、“显着低”或“异常低”。 “继春季和夏季异常干旱之后，这是过去五年来第三次干旱状况迅速加剧，”水文学家史蒂夫·特纳说。

reflection.en: The prolonged drought and heatwaves described in the report paint a stark picture of scarcity, impacting millions across England and Wales. In such times, Habakkuk 3:17-18 offers a profound perspective: even when the fields yield no harvest and the livestock perish, we can find our joy and strength in Yahweh. This ancient wisdom calls us to root our hope...
reflection.zh: 报道中描述的长期干旱和热浪描绘了一幅严峻的资源匮乏景象，影响着英格兰和威尔士的数百万人。在这样的时刻，《哈巴谷书》3:17-18 提供了深刻的视角：即使田地没有收成，牲畜也灭绝，我们仍能在雅伟里找到喜乐和力量。这古老的智慧呼唤我们将希望扎根于我们创造主的持久信实，而非世俗资源的丰盛。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: One still missing after Grand Canyon floods kill two and prompt rescue efforts
title.zh: 科罗拉多大峡谷洪水致两人死亡，搜救行动仍在进行

summary.en: Two people have died and one remains missing after flash floods swept through parts of the Grand Canyon, prompting extensive rescue operations. Most of the 30 people initially unaccounted for have been located, with dozens airlifted to safety.
summary.zh: 科罗拉多大峡谷部分地区遭遇山洪爆发，已造成两人死亡，一人失踪，搜救行动正在进行中。最初失联的30人中，大部分已被找到，数十人已被空运至安全地带。

body.en:
All but one person missing after flash flooding devastated parts of the Grand Canyon has now been found, the National Parks Service (NPS) says.

Thirty people had previously been unaccounted for, but rangers "worked tirelessly" to reduce that number, Incident Commander Dave Black told reporters on Monday.

At least two people died after floodwaters struck on Saturday afternoon, wiping out footbridges and propelling boulders downstream.

Crews had "worked incredibly hard trying to get this situation under control", Black said during Monday's press conference.

This involved the airlift of dozens of people in Phantom Ranch, one of the park's hardest-hit areas, he added.

An initial 45 people were evacuated by air on Saturday, and a remaining group of 37 were later evacuated by Sunday afternoon, Black said.

Crews will be deployed on Tuesday morning to search for the final missing person in the area between Phantom Ranch and Cottonwood Manzanita.

Further heavy rain was forecast overnight from Monday into Tuesday, bringing an elevated risk of additional flash flooding to the area.

Black described the two individuals who died as adult males, adding he would not disclose any further details about their identities.

The NPS earlier said it had found the body of a 46-year-old man near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River.

The "significant" flooding began in Bright Angel Canyon around 14:30 local time (19:30 BST) on Saturday, the NPS previously said.

Nikki Baggs, 41, who was among those to be airlifted out of the bottom of the Grand Canyon with her two friends, told the BBC: "The whole thing was terrifying.

Nearly all footbridges across Bright Angel Creek were destroyed, and the parks service closed down Phantom Ranch, Bright Angel Campground, the entire North Kaibab Trail to Phantom Ranch, Black Bridge, Silver Bridge and the Colorado River.

On Monday, the NPS said that preliminary assessments indicated about 40% of the Transcanyon Waterline, which delivers water for visitors and approximately 2,500 residents, was damaged or destroyed in the flood.

The Grand Canyon is one of the most popular national parks in the US, with about five million people visiting each year. The Bright Angel trail is its most popular hike.

The recent rains in the Grand Canyon area, and more widely in south-western parts of the US, are due to monsoonal showers.

A change in wind direction at this time of year pulls warm, moist air northward from the Gulf of California and the tropical Pacific, triggering storms over mountainous terrain.

The storms are difficult to pinpoint in forecasts and so can strike without warning. But because the ground is usually very dry, any heavy downpours lead to dangerous flash flooding and frequent lightning which increases the threat of...
body.zh: 国家公园管理局 (NPS) 表示，大峡谷部分地区因山洪暴发而失踪，目前除一名失踪人员外，其余人员均已找到。 事件指挥官戴夫·布莱克周一告诉记者，此前已有三十人下落不明，但护林员“不知疲倦地工作”以减少这一数字。 周六下午洪水袭击，冲毁了人行天桥，并将巨石推向下游，造成至少两人死亡。 布莱克在周一的新闻发布会上表示，克鲁斯“非常努力地试图控制局势”。 他补充说，这涉及到幻影牧场（公园受灾最严重的地区之一）的数十人的空运。 布莱克说，最初的 45 人于周六乘飞机疏散，其余 37 人随后于周日下午疏散。 工作人员将于周二早上部署在幻影牧场和卡顿伍德曼萨尼塔之间的地区寻找最后一名失踪人员。 预计周一至周二夜间还会有大雨，导致该地区发生额外山洪的风险增加。 布莱克将两名死亡者描述为成年男性，并补充说他不会透露有关他们身份的任何进一步细节。 NPS 早些时候表示，在科罗拉多河沿岸的水晶急流附近发现了一名 46 岁男子的尸体。 NPS 此前表示，当地时间周六 14:30（英国夏令时 19:30）左右，光明天使峡谷开始出现“严重”洪水。 41 岁的妮基·巴格斯 (Nikki Baggs) 是与她的两个朋友一起从大峡谷底部被空运出来的人之一，她告诉 BBC：“整件事非常可怕。 几乎所有横跨光明天使溪的人行桥都被摧毁，公园管理局关闭了幻影牧场、光明天使营地、通往幻影牧场的整个北凯巴布步道、黑桥、银桥和科罗拉多河。 周一，NPS 表示，初步评估显示，为游客和约 2,500 名居民供水的跨峡谷水线约有 40% 在洪水中受损或毁坏。 大峡谷是美国最受欢迎的国家公园之一，每年约有 500 万人参观。光明天使步道是最受欢迎的徒步路线。 最近大峡谷地区以及美国西南部地区的降雨是由季风阵雨造成的。 每年这个时候风向的变化会将温暖潮湿的空气从加利福尼亚湾和热带太平洋吹向北方，在山区引发风暴。 风暴很难在预报中精确定位，因此可能会在毫无预警的情况下突然袭来。但由于地面通常非常干燥，任何大雨都会导致危险的山洪和频繁的闪电，从而增加了……的威胁。

reflection.en: The sudden fury of nature in the Grand Canyon, which claimed lives and endangered hikers, serves as a stark reminder of our vulnerability. In such moments of crisis, when the earth itself seems to rage, Psalm 46:1 offers solace, reminding us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 科罗拉多大峡谷突如其来的自然之怒夺去了生命并危及了徒步旅行者，这鲜明地提醒了我们的脆弱。在这样的危机时刻，当大地本身似乎在咆哮时，诗篇46:1提供了慰藉，提醒我们雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - video
title.zh: 人类能与鲸鱼交流吗？- 视频

summary.en: Since the first recording of whale song in 1949, researchers have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. As technology advances, scientists are deciphering these intricate patterns, which could aid in protecting whales from human-caused threats.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员一直被它们复杂的发声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译这些复杂的模式，这可能有助于保护鲸鱼免受人类造成的威胁。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast Conservation Foundation 2. Footage courtesy of Raincoast Conservation Foundation - Obtained for research under SARA permit XMMS 4 2026 3. Video by Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 4. Footage courtesy of Valeria Vergara and GREMM. Obtained for research under SARA permits QUE-MM02-2016 and QUE-LEP-001-2018 5. Project CETI 6. Project CETI Continue reading...
body.zh: 自从 1949 年录制了已知最早的鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员就一直被它们交流时的哀号、隆隆声、咔哒声、咕噜声和尖叫声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译使不同物种的发声与众不同的复杂模式。马德琳·芬利听到艾玛·布莱斯的来信，她是一名记者，花了几个月的时间调查人类理解鲸鱼歌曲的努力。她解释了这些知识如何帮助我们更好地保护鲸鱼免受人为伤害。鸣谢： 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast 保护基金会 2. 影片由 Raincoast 保护基金会提供 - 根据 SARA 许可 XMMS 4 2026 获得用于研究 3. 视频由 Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 提供 4. 影片由 Valeria Vergara 和 GREMM 提供。根据 SARA 许可证 QUE-MM02-2016 和 QUE-LEP-001-2018 获得研究 5. reflection.en: The persistent curiosity of scientists studying whale song, as detailed since the 1949 recording, echoes the ancient wisdom found in observing the natural world. Job 12:7 reminds us that creation itself speaks volumes, offering profound insights to those who pause to listen and learn from its intricate designs.
reflection.zh: 自1949年录音以来，科学家们对鲸鱼歌声的持续好奇心，呼应了观察自然界所能获得的古老智慧。约伯记12:7提醒我们，造物本身就蕴含着丰富的启示，为那些停下来倾听并学习其精妙设计的人提供深刻的见解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Mindfulness may lower blood pressure in just 8 weeks
title.zh: 正念可能在短短8周内降低血压

summary.en: Mindfulness, gratitude, and optimism training may improve blood pressure, inflammation, and other heart-health measures within just eight to 12 weeks. The strongest programs paired daily practice with regular reinforcement, suggesting that improving psychological well-being can lead to better physical health outcomes.
summary.zh: 正念、感恩和乐观训练可以在短短八到十二周内改善血压、炎症和其他心脏健康指标。最有效的项目将日常练习与定期强化相结合，表明改善心理健康可以带来更好的身体健康结果。

body.en:
Simple practices such as mindfulness, gratitude journaling, and optimism training may improve several markers of cardiovascular health within a matter of weeks. A recent study found that these positive psychology interventions were consistently associated with improvements in blood pressure, inflammation, and other heart disease risk factors. Because some of the benefits appeared to be connected with healthier behaviors, including better eating habits and increased physical activity, the researchers said continued reinforcement may be necessary to maintain progress over time.

Rosalba (Rose) Hernandez, a professor of social work at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, led the research team. The group reviewed results from 18 randomized controlled trials that tested positive psychology and mindfulness interventions designed to improve mental or physical health.

The programs varied widely in how they were delivered. Some relied on structured phone sessions, journaling paired with brief check-ins, or digital tools such as apps and text messages. Others involved interactive in-person group meetings or hybrid approaches that combined face-to-face activities with online tools and virtual sessions.

Most programs included weekly sessions along with activities participants completed at home to reinforce what they had learned. The majority lasted between six and 12 weeks.

The studies generally enrolled groups of 50-200 adults who already had elevated cardiovascular risk, including uncontrolled hypertension, heart failure, or other health conditions. Participants were usually in their late 50s to mid-60s. Among studies that reported gender, women made up 35-55% of the participants.

"In hypertension and postacute coronary syndrome cohorts, mindfulness-based programs delivered over an eight-week period reduced systolic blood pressure and lowered inflammatory markers such as high-sensitivity C-reactive protein and fibrinogen," said Hernandez, who is a Fellow of the American Heart Association. "A 12-week spirituality-based digital intervention achieved one of the largest reductions -- reducing systolic blood pressure measured with a standard cuff by 7.6 points, and central systolic pressure -- which is measured in the aorta as it leaves the heart -- by 4.1 points."

Previous research on positive psychology often did not clearly establish how frequently people needed to practice these techniques, or for how long, to gain health benefits, Hernandez said. Her team wanted to determine what level of participation was most consistently associated with improvements in cardiovascular health.

The review showed that programs with more frequent participant contact tended to produce the most reliable physiological benefits. Hernandez said this finding highlights...
body.zh: 正念、感恩日记和乐观训练等简单的练习可以在几周内改善心血管健康的多项指标。最近的一项研究发现，这些积极的心理干预措施始终与血压、炎症和其他心脏病危险因素的改善相关。由于一些好处似乎与更健康的行为有关，包括更好的饮食习惯和增加体力活动，研究人员表示，随着时间的推移，可能需要持续强化才能保持进展。 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校社会工作教授罗萨尔巴·埃尔南德斯（Rosalba Hernandez）领导了该研究小组。该小组审查了 18 项随机对照试验的结果，这些试验测试了旨在改善心理或身体健康的积极心理学和正念干预措施。 这些项目的交付方式差异很大。有些人依赖结构化电话会议、日记和简短的签到，或者应用程序和短信等数字工具。其他活动则涉及交互式面对面小组会议或将面对面活动与在线工具和虚拟会议相结合的混合方法。 大多数项目包括每周一次的课程以及参与者在家完成的活动，以巩固他们所学到的知识。大多数持续 6 到 12 周。 这些研究通常招募了 50-200 名患有心血管疾病风险较高的成年人，包括未受控制的高血压、心力衰竭或其他健康状况。参与者通常在 50 多岁到 60 多岁之间。在报告性别的研究中，女性占参与者的 35-55%。 美国心脏协会会员埃尔南德斯说：“在高血压和急性冠脉综合征队列中，为期八周的基于正念的计划降低了收缩压，并降低了高敏 C 反应蛋白和纤维蛋白原等炎症标志物。” “为期 12 周的基于灵性的数字干预实现了最大程度的降低之一——使用标准袖带测量的收缩压降低了 7.6 点，中心收缩压（在主动脉离开心脏时测量的）降低了 4.1 点。” 埃尔南德斯说，之前关于积极心理学的研究通常没有明确确定人们需要多长时间练习这些技巧，或者练习多长时间才能获得健康益处。她的团队希望确定什么程度的参与与心血管健康的改善最相关。 审查表明，参与者接触越频繁的项目往往会产生最可靠的生理益处。埃尔南德斯说，这一发现凸显了......

reflection.en: This study offers a hopeful perspective on the mind-body connection, suggesting that cultivating inner peace through practices like mindfulness can have tangible benefits for our physical health. It echoes the ancient wisdom that a healthy spirit contributes to a healthy body, reminding us that tending to our emotional and mental well-being is a vital part...
reflection.zh: 这项研究为身心联系提供了一个充满希望的视角，表明通过正念等练习培养内心的平静可以对我们的身体健康产生切实的益处。它呼应了古老的智慧，即健康的灵有助于健康的体魄，提醒我们照顾好自己的情感和心理健康是整体护理的重要组成部分。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Scientists discover why snake embryos twist into spirals
title.zh: 科学家发现蛇胚胎为何卷成螺旋形

summary.en: An international research team has discovered a likely reason why snake embryos curl into tight right-handed spirals before hatching. The coiling appears to be a mechanism to accommodate their exceptionally long bodies, as the rapid lengthening of the embryo's body outpaces its gut, creating a tether that forces it to...
summary.zh: 一个国际研究小组发现了一个可能的解释，说明为什么蛇胚胎在孵化前会卷成紧密的右旋螺旋形。这种卷曲似乎是为了适应它们异常长的身体，因为胚胎身体的快速增长超过了其肠道的增长速度，形成了一个束缚，迫使其弯曲和扭曲。

body.en:
An international research team led by scientists in Canada has uncovered a likely explanation for one of the more unusual features of snake development: why embryos curl into tight spirals before hatching. This coiling behavior appears to help snakes accommodate the exceptionally long bodies that distinguish them from every other vertebrate.

The findings, published in Current Biology , suggest that the spiral forms as the embryo's body rapidly lengthens while its gut acts as a tether. That physical constraint causes the growing body to buckle and twist into a right-handed coil.

"It's like when you adjust the length of a strap and the longer, buckling side of the loop twists," explains senior author and team leader Dr. Tetsuto Miyashita, evolutionary biologist at the Canadian Museum of Nature.

The discovery adds snake embryos to a long list of naturally occurring spiral structures that scientists are still working to understand.

"There is a touch of mystery to spirals, and we are only beginning to understand how these shapes are produced in animals, such as our looping intestine, snail shells, and now these beautifully coiled snake embryos," says lead author Alexandra Weber, now a graduate student in zoology at the University of British Columbia.

Adds Miyashita: "These puzzles beckon our curiosity. After all, spiral forms in nature have inspired human creations ranging from rotini pasta, to a barber's pole or even portrayals of the biblical 'Tower of Babel'."

The project itself grew out of an unusual circumstance. During the COVID lockdown in 2020, Miyashita was working from home and looking for a research question his students could investigate without access to laboratories or museum collections.

"Then the lightbulb turned on. I had inherited from my PhD advisor this fascination with asymmetries in animal forms. So every time I saw images of snake embryos in papers, I wondered whether they are right- or left-handed in their coiling."

Miyashita asked Weber, who was then at Carleton University, along with two undergraduate students at the University of Ottawa, to search published research and museum databases for photographs of developing snakes.

"We obtained pictures for more than 900 embryos from 39 snake and other limbless squamate species. That's a statistically robust sample."

A clear pattern emerged. During the first several weeks after the eggs were laid, the embryos appeared to coil only dextrally, meaning to the right, as viewed from head to tail.

"At these stages, the embryos don't have muscles to move with, so different forces are making them coil right-handed," Weber explains. "But we didn't know what's making them do that."

Because the embryos were not yet capable of actively moving their bodies into position, the researchers...
body.zh: 由加拿大科学家领导的一个国际研究小组发现了蛇发育的一个更不寻常的特征的可能解释：为什么胚胎在孵化前卷曲成紧密的螺旋。这种盘绕行为似乎有助于蛇适应超长的身体，这使蛇与其他脊椎动物区别开来。 发表在《当代生物学》上的研究结果表明，螺旋是随着胚胎的身体迅速拉长而形成的，而其肠道则充当了系绳的作用。这种身体限制导致生长中的身体弯曲并扭曲成右手线圈。 “这就像当你调整带子的长度和环扭曲的较长、弯曲的一侧时，”加拿大自然博物馆的进化生物学家、资深作者和团队负责人 Tetsuto Miyashita 博士解释道。 这一发现将蛇胚胎添加到一长串自然存在的螺旋结构中，科学家们仍在努力了解这些结构。 “螺旋有一丝神秘感，我们才刚刚开始了解这些形状是如何在动物身上产生的，比如我们的环形肠道、蜗牛壳，以及现在这些美丽的盘绕蛇胚胎，”主要作者、不列颠哥伦比亚大学动物学研究生亚历山德拉·韦伯说。 宫下补充道：“这些谜题唤起了我们的好奇心。毕竟，自然界中的螺旋形状激发了人类的创作灵感，从罗蒂尼面食到理发店的柱子，甚至是圣经中‘巴别塔’的描绘。” 该项目本身是在一个不寻常的情况下产生的。在 2020 年新冠疫情封锁期间，宫下在家工作，寻找学生可以在不进入实验室或博物馆藏品的情况下进行研究的研究问题。 “然后灯泡亮了。我从我的博士导师那里继承了对动物形态不对称的迷恋。所以每次我在论文中看到蛇胚胎的图像时，我都想知道它们在盘绕时是右手还是左手。” 宫下要求当时就读于卡尔顿大学的韦伯以及渥太华大学的两名本科生在已发表的研究和博物馆数据库中搜索蛇发育过程中的照片。 “我们获得了 39 种蛇和其他无肢有鳞动物的 900 多个胚胎的照片。这是一个统计上可靠的样本。” 一个清晰的模式出现了。在产卵后的最初几周内，胚胎似乎仅向右卷曲，即从头到尾观察时向右卷曲。 韦伯解释说：“在这些阶段，胚胎没有肌肉可以移动，因此不同的力量使它们以右手方式卷曲。” “但我们不知道是什么让他们这样做。” 由于胚胎尚不能主动将其身体移动到位，研究人员...

reflection.en: The intricate design of a snake embryo, twisting into a spiral to accommodate its growing body, is a testament to the wisdom embedded in creation. As Job reminds us, observing the natural world can teach us profound truths about the Creator's ingenuity and purpose. May we approach scientific discovery with humility, recognizing that each new insight into...
reflection.zh: 蛇胚胎为适应其生长身体而扭曲成螺旋形的复杂设计，证明了造物中蕴含的智慧。正如约伯所提醒我们的，观察自然界可以教会我们关于创造者创造力和目的的深刻真理。 愿我们以谦卑的态度进行科学探索，认识到生命机制的每一个新发现都揭示了雅伟那精湛的杰作。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Charmed by comets
title.zh: 迷恋彗星

summary.en: This week's selection from the Nature archive celebrates astronomy, a field that has long captured human imagination, and also touches on the health benefits of sunshine and the outdoors.
summary.zh: 本周精选的《自然》杂志文章，颂扬了长期以来一直吸引人们想象力的天文学，并探讨了阳光和户外活动的健康益处。

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos, explored through astronomy, has always inspired awe and wonder. As we gaze at the stars and celestial bodies, we are reminded of the intricate design and order of creation. This pursuit of knowledge about the universe is a way of observing and learning from the world around us, reflecting the wisdom inherent in God's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙，通过天文学的探索，一直激发着敬畏和惊奇。当我们仰望星辰和天体时，我们被提醒造物所蕴含的精妙设计和秩序。这种对宇宙知识的追求，是一种观察和学习我们周围世界的方式，反映了雅伟杰作中固有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: China’s regulatory innovation for new biomedical technologies
title.zh: 中国对新型生物医学技术的监管创新

summary.en: China is pioneering new regulatory approaches for emerging biomedical technologies, aiming to balance innovation with safety and ethical considerations. This initiative reflects a global trend of adapting regulatory frameworks to the rapid pace of scientific advancement in fields like gene editing and AI-driven drug...
summary.zh: 中国正在为新兴生物医学技术开创新的监管方法，旨在平衡创新与安全和伦理考量。这一举措反映了全球适应基因编辑和人工智能驱动的药物发现等领域科学技术快速发展的监管框架的趋势。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of biomedical technologies, as seen in China's regulatory innovations, mirrors the prophecy that 'knowledge will increase' in the end times. This surge in human understanding calls for wisdom and ethical guidance, reminding us that all knowledge ultimately comes from the Creator.
reflection.zh: 中国在生物医学技术监管方面的创新，反映了但以理所预言的“知识必增长”的时代特征。人类知识的飞速增长呼唤着智慧和伦理的指引，提醒我们一切知识的源头在于创造者雅伟。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

title.en: Without new landers or rovers, it's helicopters or bust for NASA's Mars program
title.zh: 没有新的着陆器或探测器，NASA的火星计划要么是直升机，要么就完蛋

summary.en: NASA's cost estimate for SR-1 Freedom is $2.1 billion, but that doesn't include the helicopters.
summary.zh: NASA对SR-1自由号的成本估算为21亿美元，但这不包括直升机。

body.en: For the first time in more than 30 years, NASA has no firm plans to send any new landers or rovers to Mars. Instead, the agency's near-term focus at the red planet is on aerial drones, a pioneering mode of exploration that didn't seem realistic until a few years ago. The first real use of drones for science at Mars will come with the SkyFall mission, a fleet of three helicopters set for launch as soon as late 2028. SkyFall's helicopters will ride to the red planet with NASA's Space Reactor-1 "Freedom" mission , which has the primary objective of demonstrating nuclear electric propulsion in deep space. The launch schedule is aggressive for SR-1 Freedom and SkyFall, projects that didn't even exist in NASA's portfolio six months ago. NASA's plan for the SR-1 Freedom mission, estimated to cost $2.1 billion, calls for repurposing the core module of the canceled Gateway lunar space station into a testbed for nuclear electric propulsion. SkyFall will build on NASA's success with the Ingenuity helicopter, an experimental vehicle that became the first rotorcraft to fly on another world in 2021. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 三十多年来，美国宇航局首次没有向火星发送任何新着陆器或漫游车的明确计划。相反，该机构近期对这颗红色星球的关注重点是无人机，这是一种开创性的探索模式，直到几年前似乎还不太现实。无人机在火星上的首次真正使用将伴随着 SkyFall 任务，该任务由三架直升机组成，最快将于 2028 年末发射。SkyFall 的直升机将与 NASA 的 Space Reactor-1“自由”任务一起飞往这颗红色星球，该任务的主要目标是在深空演示核电推进。 SR-1 Freedom 和 SkyFall 的发射时间表非常紧迫，这两个项目在六个月前甚至不存在于 NASA 的投资组合中。 NASA 的 SR-1 Freedom 任务计划估计耗资 21 亿美元，要求将已取消的 Gateway 月球空间站的核心模块重新利用为核电推进试验台。 SkyFall 将以 NASA Ingenuity 直升机的成功为基础，Ingenuity 直升机是一种实验飞行器，于 2021 年成为第一架在另一个世界飞行的旋翼飞机。 阅读全文

reflection.en: NASA's Mars program is pivoting from ground-based exploration to aerial drones, with a fleet of three helicopters planned for a 2028 launch. This bold step into the unknown, focusing on innovative aerial reconnaissance, reminds us of the profound questions about our place in the cosmos. As we reach further into the heavens, we are continually reminded of...
reflection.zh: NASA的火星计划正从地面探索转向空中无人机，计划在2028年发射三架直升机。这一大胆迈向未知的步伐，专注于创新的空中侦察，让我们回想起关于我们在宇宙中位置的深刻问题。当我们向天堂伸出更远的手时，我们不断被提醒周围的浩瀚与神秘，这激发了对创造之宏大规模的敬畏与惊奇。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
title.zh: 人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，安德鲁·贝利警告G20

summary.en: The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could lead to a global economic downturn and pose significant cybersecurity risks to financial systems. Andrew Bailey stated that a collapse in the AI sector could trigger a worldwide market correction, and urged...
summary.zh: 英格兰银行行长警告G20财政部长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退并对金融系统构成重大的网络安全风险。安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业的增长崩溃可能引发全球市场调整，并敦促公司为广泛的安全漏洞做好准备。

body.en:
The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could cause a global economic downturn and pose a significant cyber security risk to financial systems.

Andrew Bailey said any collapse of growth in the AI sector could lead to a "future market correction" that spreads worldwide.

In an open letter to finance ministers in the US on Monday, he said companies around the world should prepare for security breaches "involving simultaneous disruption across multiple firms".

Earlier this month, a group of 100 firms , including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, urged countries and groups to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

Bailey told the G20 finance ministers that a combination of highly priced stock markets, increased borrowing by investors, and the growing concentration of money into a small number of major technology companies could amplify any future market correction.

"The issue is not simply that investors are borrowing more, but that leverage is interacting with high valuations and market concentration, in particular the increasing cross-investment between artificial intelligence (AI) companies and hyper scalers, in a way that could amplify a future market correction," he said.

Bailey has called on those in charge of financial security to develop "appropriate steps to support safe and responsible model release and deployment on a global basis".

Bailey, who was writing in his capacity as chairman of the Financial Stability Board international watchdog (FSB), expressed concern about the "volatility" prompted by the effect of energy supply shocks caused by the US-Iran war.

His warning comes as the UK government is seeking to grow the country's "sovereign AI" capacity, developing homegrown AI technology to ensure the UK is not dependent on services from abroad.

Ministers want to see companies compete for the funding to help tackle challenges like cutting waiting lists in the NHS and bolstering cybersecurity and defence.

But there is growing concern that AI companies are increasingly developing models that can easily override the safeguarding systems of banks and financial centres.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

The FSB which Bailey leads is a global watchdog which monitors finance ministry officials, banks and securities regulators. It includes officials from the US, UK, France, Germany, Canada, Japan, Australia, China and Saudi Arabia.
body.zh: 英国央行行长警告二十国集团财长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，并对金融系统构成重大网络安全风险。 安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业增长的任何崩溃都可能导致全球范围内的“未来市场调整”。 他在周一致美国财政部长的公开信中表示，世界各地的公司应该为“涉及多家公司同时中断”的安全漏洞做好准备。 本月早些时候，包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司敦促各国和组织加强网络防御，以免人工智能强大到足以超越它们。 贝利向二十国集团财长们表示，股市价格高昂、投资者借贷增加以及资金日益集中于少数主要科技公司，这些因素结合在一起可能会放大未来的市场调整。 他表示：“问题不仅仅是投资者借入更多资金，而是杠杆与高估值和市场集中度相互作用，特别是人工智能（AI）公司和超大规模企业之间日益增加的交叉投资，从而可能放大未来的市场调整。” 贝利呼吁负责金融安全的人员制定“适当的措施，支持在全球范围内安全、负责任地发布和部署模型”。 贝利以金融稳定委员会国际监管机构（FSB）主席的身份撰写文章，对美伊战争造成的能源供应冲击所引发的“波动”表示担忧。 几个月前，英国财政大臣约翰·希利宣布设立一项旨在支持英国人工智能初创企业的 1 亿英镑基金。 这是政府增强国家“主权人工智能”能力、开发本土人工智能技术以确保英国不依赖国外服务的努力的一部分。 部长们希望看到企业争夺资金，以帮助应对诸如减少 NHS 等候名单以及加强网络安全和防御等挑战。 英国政府发言人表示，其新成立的人工智能经济研究所正在与国际合作伙伴合作，“就人工智能如何改变世界各地的经济建立更强有力的共识”。 该发言人表示：“该研究所是同类中第一个由政府支持的机构，专注于人工智能的经济影响，帮助政策制定者了解随着技术的快速发展，人工智能对增长、生产力、就业和公共服务意味着什么。” 但人们越来越担心人工智能公司正在越来越多地开发可以轻松超越银行和金融保护系统的模型......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings both immense promise and potential peril, as highlighted by the Bank of England's warning. Like the testing of character through praise, the development and integration of AI require careful discernment and preparation for unforeseen consequences, lest our ambition outstrip our wisdom. As we navigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展既带来了巨大的希望，也带来了潜在的危险，正如英格兰银行的警告所指出的那样。就像赞美会考验人的品格一样，人工智能的开发和整合需要审慎的辨别和对不可预见后果的准备，以免我们的野心超越我们的智慧。...

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Private group wants to launch "cheapest possible" mission to Alpha Centauri
title.zh: 私人团体希望启动“最便宜”的阿尔法半人马座任务

summary.en: A private group aims to launch the most affordable mission possible to Alpha Centauri, driven by concerns about the Fermi paradox and the potential existence of a 'great filter' that prevents advanced civilizations from spreading.
summary.zh: 一个私人团体旨在启动有史以来最便宜的阿尔法半人马座任务，其动机是对费米悖论和可能存在的阻止先进文明扩散的“大过滤器”的担忧。

body.en: There are, by various estimates, several trillion planets within what is known as the Local Group of galaxies—our closest galaxy neighbors, including our own Milky Way. Many of these planets are within the habitable zone of their stars. So if life finds a way, where are the alien civilizations? This is the crux of what is known as the Fermi paradox , which posits that if life is fairly common in the Universe, humans should have collected credible evidence for the existence of extraterrestrial civilizations by now. People who think about this paradox believe there may be some "filter" that limits or entirely prevents an advanced civilization from sending out probes or even life-bearing spacecraft to nearby stars. Philip Johnston is someone who thinks a lot about the Fermi paradox. A mathematician and physicist from the United Kingdom, Johnston has gained some notoriety lately in the space community as one of the biggest proponents of orbital data centers. He co-founded Starcloud in 2024 to develop such data centers, and the company is presently valued at $2.3 billion. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 根据各种估计，在所谓的本星系群（我们最近的星系邻居，包括我们自己的银河系）内有数万亿颗行星。其中许多行星都位于其恒星的宜居带内。那么如果生命找到了出路，那么外星文明在哪里呢？这就是所谓的费米悖论的症结所在，该悖论假设，如果生命在宇宙中相当普遍，那么人类现在应该已经收集到了外星文明存在的可靠证据。思考这一悖论的人们认为，可能存在某种“过滤器”，限制或完全阻止先进文明向附近的恒星发射探测器，甚至是承载生命的航天器。菲利普·约翰斯顿是一位对费米悖论思考很多的人。约翰斯顿是一位来自英国的数学家和物理学家，作为轨道数据中心的最大支持者之一，他最近在太空界声名狼藉。他于 2024 年与他人共同创立了 Starcloud，致力于开发此类数据中心，该公司目前估值为 23 亿美元。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The ambition to reach Alpha Centauri, while a testament to human ingenuity, echoes the ancient story of the Tower of Babel. In our quest to overcome cosmic distances and perhaps the 'great filter,' we must remember that true progress is not solely measured by technological reach, but by our humility and wisdom in pursuing it. May our endeavors be guided by...
reflection.zh: 飞往阿尔法半人马座的雄心壮志，虽然是人类智慧的证明，却也呼应了古老的巴别塔故事。在我们试图克服宇宙距离和可能存在的“大过滤器”的过程中，我们必须记住，真正的进步不仅仅是通过技术的 alcance 来衡量，更是通过我们追求技术时的谦逊和智慧。愿我们的努力以理解我们在创造中的位置为指导，而不是超越我们的极限。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: The Bentley Supersports: A stripped-out engineer's indulgence
title.zh: 宾利Supersports：轻量化的工程师放纵之作

summary.en: It's the lightest Bentley in 85 years.
summary.zh: 这是85年来最轻的宾利。

body.en: Bentley provided flights from Washington, DC, to Monterey, California, and accommodation so Ars could drive the Supersports, as well as ride in a preproduction Torcal EV, which we wrote about last week. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. MONTEREY, Calif.—Last week, we brought news of the Bentley Torcal, a new electric vehicle that the luxury automaker has been cooking up at its HQ in Crewe, England. The company wants to attract new customers with its first battery EV, part of a plan to make sustainability as much a part of the brand's character as its high-end fit and finish. W12 engines have given way to V8 plug-in hybrid power, and the new Continental GT is all the better for it . But around the same time as Ars got its first experience of that new PHEV two-door on a rather wet Spanish racetrack, some of Bentley's boffins were wondering what might happen if you also built one without the hybrid stuff. Or all-wheel drive—something that has been a characteristic of every new road-going Bentley since the turn of the century. That would certainly cut the curb weight. So, too, would leaving out the rear seats. That sort of idea leads down a well-trodden path for some OEMs, and Porsche in particular is famous for making stripped-out road cars inspired by its race cars and making money from them, too. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾利提供从华盛顿特区飞往加利福尼亚州蒙特雷的航班，并提供住宿，以便 Ars 可以驾驶 Supersports，并乘坐我们上周写过的预生产 Torcal 电动汽车。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。加利福尼亚州蒙特利——上周，我们带来了宾利托卡尔 (Bentley Torcal) 的消息，这是一家豪华汽车制造商在其位于英国克鲁的总部研发的一款新型电动汽车。该公司希望通过其首款电池电动汽车吸引新客户，这是一项计划的一部分，旨在使可持续发展与高端装配和装饰一样成为该品牌特色的一部分。 W12 发动机已经让位于 V8 插电式混合动力，而新款欧陆 GT 则更胜一筹。但大约在同一时间，当 Ars 在相当潮湿的西班牙赛道上首次体验这款新型 PHEV 两门车时，宾利的一些研究人员想知道，如果您也制造一辆没有混合动力的汽车，会发生什么。或者全轮驱动——自世纪之交以来，这一直是每辆新款公路宾利汽车的特征。这肯定会减少整备重量。因此，也可以省略后排座椅。这种想法为一些原始设备制造商带来了一条常见的道路，尤其是保时捷，以制造受其赛车启发的精简公路车并从中赚钱而闻名。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Bentley's engineers have crafted their lightest car in 85 years, a testament to meticulous design and skilled labor. This dedication to excellence in their work echoes the biblical call to 'do everything for the glory of God,' finding purpose and honor in the quality of one's craft.
reflection.zh: 宾利的工程师们打造出了85年来最轻的汽车，这是精湛设计和熟练技艺的证明。这种对卓越工作的奉献精神，呼应了圣经中“凡所行的，都为荣耀神”的呼召，在技艺的品质中找到目标和荣耀。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
title.zh: 亚马逊被指控操纵广告定价，面临美国各州和监管机构的诉讼

summary.en: Amazon is facing a lawsuit from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and 22 states, which alleges the company secretly overcharged over a million advertising customers by manipulating online auction prices since 2019, potentially netting $20 billion. Amazon disputes these claims, stating the FTC misunderstands their ad...
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和22个州联合对亚马逊提起诉讼，指控该公司自2019年以来通过操纵在线拍卖价格，秘密向超过一百万的广告客户收取过高费用，可能已获利200亿美元。亚马逊对此表示强烈反对，认为FTC误解了其广告市场。

body.en:
Amazon secretly overcharged more than a million advertising customers by manipulating online auctions it uses to set ad prices, according to a lawsuit filed by the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and a bipartisan group of 22 states.

According to the lawsuit, filed on Monday, the alleged scheme has likely netted the firm $20bn (£14.8bn) from advertising customers since 2019.

"Amazon overrides and replaces the actual auction results with higher prices set by Amazon to increase its profits," says a complaint filed in the company's home state of Washington.

In a statement to the BBC, Amazon said it "strongly disagrees" with the premise that it misled advertisers and called the suit "misguided."

In addition to advertisers, the FTC, a US consumer watchdog, and the states say Amazon customers have also been harmed as extra costs are passed onto shoppers.

"Consumers are suffering, have suffered, and will continue to suffer substantial injury as a result," the complaint states, prompting swift pushback from Amazon.

"The FTC wants the public to believe this case is about higher prices for consumers. It is not," Amazon said in its statement.

The company's shares fell following the announcement of the lawsuit, closing 2.5% lower on Monday.

Many brands and sellers compete on Amazon to place Sponsored Product ads and Sponsored Brands ads when consumer search for products using keywords on Amazon's e-commerce platform.

The complaint accuses Amazon of secretly charging advertisers more in so-called "second price" auctions, whereby prospective advertisers expect to pay one cent more than the next highest bidder for each bid they win.

But in practice, the complaint alleges, Amazon has charged its Sponsored Products advertisers their own winning bid close to 80% of the time.

The lawsuit states that Amazon's methods were spurred because "it was unhappy about how much revenue its advertising auctions were generating".

Amazon responded by saying the FTC "fundamentally misunderstands how advertisers operate".

"Advertisers adjust bids based on real-world performance, not descriptions of auction mechanics," Amazon said in its statement.

"Average winning bids fell 50% from 2019 to 2025 on Sponsored Products search ads, and roughly 92% of placed ads are not given to the highest bid," the company added.

Last year, it settled a case with the FTC that alleged that it enrolled millions of consumers in its Prime subscription offering without their consent, and knowingly made it difficult for consumers to cancel.

Amazon settled the case for $2.5bn, including civil penalties and consumer refunds.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和一个由 22 个州组成的两党组织已提起诉讼，指控亚马逊通过操纵用于设定广告价格的在线拍卖，秘密向超过 100 万广告客户收取过高费用。 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和各州在周一提起的诉讼中表示，自 2019 年以来，涉嫌的计划可能已使该公司从广告客户中获利 200 亿美元。 在该公司总部华盛顿州提交的一份投诉称，“亚马逊为了增加利润而设定了更高的价格，从而推翻并取代了实际的拍卖结果。” 在给 BBC 的一份声明中，亚马逊“强烈不同意”其误导广告商的前提，并称该诉讼“具有误导性”。 除了广告商之外，美国消费者监管机构联邦贸易委员会和各州表示，由于额外成本转嫁给购物者，亚马逊的客户也受到了伤害。 投诉称：“消费者正在遭受、已经遭受并将继续遭受重大伤害。”这引发了亚马逊的迅速反击。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“联邦贸易委员会希望公众相信此案是为了向消费者收取更高的价格。但事实并非如此。” 诉讼公告公布后，该公司股价下跌，周一收盘下跌 2.5%。 当消费者在亚马逊电子商务平台上使用关键字搜索产品时，许多品牌和卖家都在亚马逊上竞争投放商品推广广告和品牌推广广告。 起诉书指控亚马逊在所谓的“第二价格”拍卖中秘密向广告商收取更高费用，即潜在的广告商希望为他们每次获胜的出价比第二高出价者多支付一美分。 但在实践中，投诉称，近 80% 的情况下，亚马逊都会向其商品推广广告商收取自己的中标费用。 该诉讼称，亚马逊的做法之所以受到刺激，是因为“它对其广告拍卖产生的收入感到不满”。 亚马逊回应称，联邦贸易委员会“从根本上误解了广告商的运作方式”。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“广告商根据现实世界的表现调整出价，而不是根据拍卖机制的描述。” 该公司补充道：“从 2019 年到 2025 年，商品推广搜索广告的平均中标出价下降了 50%，大约 92% 的投放广告没有给出最高出价。” 去年，该公司与美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 达成和解，指控该公司在未经数百万消费者同意的情况下将其纳入其 Prime 订阅服务，并故意让消费者难以取消。 亚马逊以 25 亿美元和解，包括民事罚款和消费者退款。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: This lawsuit highlights the tension between corporate profit and fair practice. The allegations suggest a deliberate manipulation of pricing, raising questions about accountability and justice in the digital marketplace. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide all economic interactions.
reflection.zh: 这项诉讼凸显了企业利润与公平交易之间的紧张关系。这些指控暗示了故意的价格操纵，引发了对数字市场中问责制和公正性的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的神同行，这些原则应指导所有经济往来。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: I've been to Gamescom six times - here's what excited me this year
title.zh: 我曾六次参加Gamescom——今年让我兴奋的是这些

summary.en: The BBC's Laura Cress gets a first look at the biggest games in Cologne from Witcher 3 to Alien: Isolation 2.
summary.zh: BBC记者劳拉·克雷斯在科隆首次看到了《巫师3》到《异形：隔离2》等大作。

body.en:
Gamescom is the largest in-person gaming event in the world, and this year it lived up to expectations with big games on show from The Witcher 3's new expansion, to Alien: Isolation 2.

Last year over 350,000 people flocked to the halls of the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany to get a chance to see and play the most hotly anticipated games.

This year that number of attendees is expected to have been even bigger, with the likes of Xbox and Sega showcasing games to the public alongside indie studios with only one or two developers.

This was my sixth time attending Gamescom, which never fails to make me excited about the games industry. Here are a few of the big things I got to check out this week.

When CD Projekt Red announced it was making a new expansion for the hugely popular action-role playing game The Witcher 3, it came as a shock.

Yet it was clear sitting in the crowd for Opening Night Live on Tuesday that there's still a lot of love for the older game. There were gasps and audible shouts of joy when the team announced they were providing a free upgrade to the original.

As for the expansion, Songs of the Past will follow the gruff-voiced protagonist Geralt in an adventure discovering more about the past of his close friend Dandelion.

Doug Cockle, who voices Geralt, told me it was a "thrill" to return as The Witcher.

"I love this character so much...it's like slipping into a warm bath, or putting on an old pair of shoes," he said.

From what I got to see, it's clear choice will once again be front and centre of the player's experience, with lots of options to choose from in how to react to people.

For those hoping to take their time tossing a coin to their Witcher, the head of co-developer Fool's Theory Jakub Rokosz told me this expansion would be "on par with the size" of previous additions such as Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone.

Alien: Isolation 2 is the long-awaited sequel to Horsham-based Creative Assembly's 2014 survival-horror game.

One of the things that made the original Alien: Isolation so terrifying was its seemingly intelligent Xenomorph, which appeared to learn from your behaviour and adapt to it.

Considering I physically jumped out of my seat at one point playing the demo when avoiding the Alien, it's safe to say Creative Assembly will once again be ratcheting up the tension with the sequel.

This time rather than playing as the daughter of Ellen Ripley, you play as Blake, a chief executive of the infamous Weyland-Yutani corporation.

As well as claustrophobic spaceship corridors, in the sequel you will also be avoiding the Alien in bigger, open air spaces.

But the game's Project Art Director Anastasia Sopikova said that did not mean you would always feel safer.

"You step outside. And you're like, 'Oh yeah, I'm...
body.zh: Gamescom 是世界上最大的现场游戏盛会，今年它不负众望，展出了从《巫师 3》新资料片到《异形：隔离 2》等大型游戏。 去年，超过 350,000 人涌入德国科隆科隆展览馆的大厅，有机会观看和体验最受期待的比赛。 今年的参加人数预计会更多，Xbox 和世嘉等公司将向公众展示游戏，而独立工作室也只有一到两名开发者。 这是我第六次参加科隆游戏展，这始终让我对游戏行业感到兴奋。以下是我本周要检查的一些重要事项。 当 CD Projekt Red 宣布将为广受欢迎的动作角色扮演游戏《巫师 3》制作新资料片时，人们感到震惊。 然而，坐在周二开幕夜现场的人群中可以明显看出，人们仍然对这款老游戏充满喜爱。当团队宣布他们将提供对原始版本的免费升级时，大家都惊呼不已，欢呼雀跃。 至于资料片，《往日之歌》将跟随声音粗哑的主角杰洛特踏上冒险之旅，更多地了解他的好友丹德里恩的过去。 为杰洛特配音的道格·科克尔告诉我，回归扮演《巫师》是一种“兴奋”。 “我非常喜欢这个角色……这就像洗个热水澡，或者穿上一双旧鞋，”他说。 从我所看到的来看，很明显，选择将再次成为玩家体验的前沿和中心，在如何对人做出反应方面有很多选项可供选择。 对于那些希望花时间向《巫师》投掷硬币的人来说，《愚人理论》的联合开发者负责人 Jakub Rokosz 告诉我，这次扩展包的规模将与《血与酒》和《石之心》等之前的新增内容“相当”。 《异形：隔离 2》是总部位于霍舍姆的 Creative Assembly 2014 年推出的生存恐怖游戏的续作，人们期待已久。 让原版《异形：隔离》如此可怕的原因之一是它看似聪明的异形，它似乎可以从你的行为中学习并适应它。 考虑到我在玩演示时在躲避外星人时从座位上跳了起来，可以肯定地说，《Creative Assembly》将再次加剧续集的紧张气氛。 这次你不再扮演艾伦·里普利的女儿，而是扮演臭名昭著的韦兰·尤塔尼公司的首席执行官布莱克。 除了幽闭恐怖的太空飞船走廊外，在续集中，你还将在更大的露天空间中躲避外星人。 但游戏的项目艺术总监阿纳斯塔西娅·索皮科娃（Anastasia Sopikova）表示，这并不意味着你总是会感到更安全。 “你走出去。你会说，‘哦，是的，我......

reflection.en: Gamescom, the world's largest in-person gaming event, showcases the latest innovations in interactive entertainment. As technology rapidly advances, Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase." This event is a vivid example of that, with hundreds of thousands gathering to experience the cutting edge of digital creation. This surge in...
reflection.zh: 作为全球最大的线下游戏盛会，Gamescom展示了互动娱乐领域的最新创新。随着科技的飞速发展，但以理的预言说，那将是“知识增长”的时代。这次盛会生动地体现了这一点，数十万人聚集于此，体验数字创作的前沿成果。 这种技术发展的激增及其广泛传播，正如游戏行业所见，促使我们思考在追求和应用新知识时应有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: US border patrol expected to aid Grand Canyon search for missing person
title.zh: 美国边境巡逻队预计将协助大峡谷搜寻失踪人员

summary.en: Nearly 80 people have been rescued, and two people confirmed dead, after flood hit national park A US border patrol technical search team is expected to deploy in the Grand Canyon, as authorities continue the search for at least one missing person after a fatal flash flood washed through the national park over the...
summary.zh: 洪水袭击国家公园后，近80人获救，两人确认死亡。美国边境巡逻队技术搜救队预计将部署在大峡谷，当局继续搜寻至少一名失踪人员，此前周末致命的山洪暴发冲毁了国家公园。由于天气预报显示更多大雨和雷暴可能引发额外的泥石流、山洪暴发或落石，当局正争分夺秒地搜寻该地区。

body.en: Nearly 80 people have been rescued, and two people confirmed dead, after flood hit national park A US border patrol technical search team is expected to deploy in the Grand Canyon, as authorities continue the search for at least one missing person after a fatal flash flood washed through the national park over the weekend. Authorities are rushing to scour the area as more heavy rain and thunderstorms in weather forecasts threaten additional debris flows, flash floods or rock falls. Continue reading...
body.zh: 洪水袭击国家公园后，已有近 80 人获救，两人确认死亡。周末，一场致命的山洪席卷了国家公园，当局将继续搜寻至少一名失踪人员，美国边境巡逻技术搜索队预计将在大峡谷部署。由于天气预报中更多的大雨和雷暴可能会引发更多的泥石流、山洪或落石，当局正在紧急搜寻该地区。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Grand Canyon, a place of immense natural beauty and power, has been violently reminded of nature's force. The flash flood that swept through the park, claiming lives and necessitating rescue efforts, illustrates the 'groaning' of creation described in Romans 8. Even in its grandeur, the natural world is subject to forces beyond human control, reminding...
reflection.zh: 大峡谷，一个拥有壮丽自然美景和力量的地方，却被无情地提醒了自然的威力。冲毁公园、夺走生命并导致救援行动的山洪暴发，恰恰说明了罗马书8章中所描述的受造之物的“叹息”。即使在其宏伟之中，自然界也受到人类无法控制的力量的影响，这提醒我们身处其中的位置。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: High winds during El Niño could be deadly for England’s stressed trees, say experts
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺期间的强风可能对英格兰压力重重的树木致命，专家称

summary.en: Experts have warned that high winds associated with El Niño could cause widespread mortality among tree species already weakened by a prolonged period of extreme heat and drought. The head of tree collections at Kew expressed significant concern for the upcoming autumn.
summary.zh: 专家警告称，与厄尔尼诺相关的强风可能导致本已因长期极端高温和干旱而衰弱的树木种类大面积死亡。邱园树木收藏主管对即将到来的秋季表示严重担忧。

body.en: Head of tree collections at Kew ‘very worried about this autumn’ as hot, dry summer has caused brittleness High winds associated with El Niño could cause widespread mortality among tree species already weakened by a prolonged period of extreme heat and drought, experts have warned. This summer much of Europe has been scorched by a series of record-breaking climate crisis-induced heatwaves . The impact is notable across much of England’s countryside, where once green land has turned brown, and many trees are undergoing “early autumn” – wilting and losing their leaves early – to cope with extreme heat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 邱园树木采集负责人“非常担心今年秋天”，因为炎热干燥的夏季会导致树木脆弱。专家警告说，与厄尔尼诺现象相关的强风可能会导致已经因长期极端高温和干旱而衰弱的树种大范围死亡。今年夏天，欧洲大部分地区遭受了一系列破纪录的气候危机引发的热浪的袭击。这种影响在英格兰大部分乡村都很显着，那里曾经的绿色土地变成了棕色，许多树木正在经历“早秋”——提前枯萎和落叶——以应对极端炎热的天气。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The natural world, from the grandest trees to the smallest creatures, groans under the weight of environmental stress. As we witness the fragility of ecosystems, we are reminded of the deep interconnectedness of all creation, a reality acknowledged in Scripture. May we approach these signs with humility, recognizing our role within this groaning creation...
reflection.zh: 大自然，从最宏伟的树木到最小的生物，都在环境压力下呻吟。当我们目睹生态系统的脆弱性时，我们被提醒所有受造物之间深层的相互联系，这是圣经中所承认的一个现实。 愿我们怀着谦卑的心态来面对这些迹象，认识到我们在这一呻吟的受造物中的角色，并寻求成为我们所受托付的大地管家之道。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - podcast
title.zh: 咔哒声、咕哝声和尖叫声：鲸鱼交流的奇迹——播客

summary.en: Since the earliest recording of whale song in 1949, scientists have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. Advances in technology are enabling researchers to decode these intricate patterns, which could lead to better whale protection from human-caused threats.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，科学家们一直被它们复杂的发声方式所吸引。技术的进步使研究人员能够解码这些复杂的模式，这可能有助于更好地保护鲸鱼免受人类的威胁。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Copyright 1978 National Geographic Society and 1977 Capitol Records, Inc.
